11871.info_text: Mainly a pub/bar, however there are a handful of arcade games at this location.

11875.info_text: The Centre for Computing History is much more than a museum. Based in Cambridge, it hosts hands-on exhibitions, educational workshops and a wide range of activities and events. Most importantly, it makes the history of computing relevant and fun for all ages! / All of the museum arcade games are set to free play, but entry is subject to an admission fee. / In addition to opening hours below, the museum also runs regular gaming nights where more cabinets and systems are displayed from the collection, including Family Gaming Nights, themed nights, and the annual Arcade Experience. / Arcade games present but not on permanent display include Tempest, Asteroids Cocktail Table, NEO-GEO MVS, Xevious, Space Invaders Part II, Super Pang (generic cabinet), Tekken 3 (generic cabinet), and Percussion Master.

11876.info_text: The Dunes is a family fun centre containing multiple attractions such as a soft play and bowling alley, but most importantly a large arcade. Also contains adult amusements, which of course are restricted to over eighteens.

11879.info_text: Biggest arcade in Bridlington, with a cinema, bowling alley, and cafe. Some decent shooting and racing games including a massive OutRun 2 setup, Also has a DDR machine.

11880.info_text: Barcade with drink holders on all the arcade cabs! / You can get a drink, play arcade games and also go to the retro room upstairs for console action. / The name "The Four Quarters" is due to you give them £1 and they give you four US quarters. / This means all games are 25p a play!

11882.info_text: Welcome to The Heart Of Gaming. We are an arcade that salvage and restore machines! / We offer an all day pass for £20 for adults or £15 for children. All machines in HOG are Free to play. / We have a mixture of arcade cabinets and consoles (PS2, PS4, Xbox 360, Mega Drive, SNES, N64, Wii, Switch). We also have two pool tables and an air hockey table. / Some of these arcade cabinets are actually Sega multipurpose arcade machines (Euro Megalo, Super Megalo 2, Megalo 430 and Naomi) so the games running on them can and will change at short notice. / The arcade is now located on North End Road located opposite Ann Summers. Look for the Playnation Games building head though the doors and head up towards the stairs on your left

11883.info_text: Entertainment Centre with Bowling, an Arcade, Minigolf and a Cinema, located just outside of Coleraine's town centre. / Hours may vary due to summer, holidays etc.

11884.info_text: Arcade with bowling and American-style cafe. Lots of redemption, a few videos, no rhythm games though. Owned by the Taylor Made Fun operators, who also own The Mint across the road and a couple other arcades. Most games are permanently there but could be switched between locations every so often.

11886.info_text: Cinema and arcade, opened May 2021 / Opening hours vary - They open 15 minutes before the first film of the day / Cabs use contactless card readers and QR code scanners instead of taking coins, and allow you to top up £5 minimum at a time. Games are across the board £1.25 per credit. / Has a Pump cab running XX, albeit offline. The cabinet is running 200% health drain and stage break, so it is much harder than normal and is likely unsuitable for most players

11887.info_text: Arcade opened up in the Cinema.

11888.info_text: adjacent to the pub. small arcade, but with a Euromix.

11889.info_text: Don't be fooled by the patched SuperNOVA decal's on one of the two machines, as that machine is infact still running EuroMIX software.

11891.info_text: By the pier's entrance, on the other side of the road from Kingpin and Fantasy World. Appears to have more coin pushers + gambling machines than Kingpin, which is also owned by Taylor Made Fun.

11893.info_text: Gaming museum. Lots of arcade games including an okay DS Fusion cab. Pushing for them to upgrade it but may take some time.

11894.info_text: Small arcade, usual non-ticket redemption, previously had EM2 but now gone :( / Not worth going out the way for / Yet another arcade owned by Sega. What more could they possibly want? Also pointless opening times too.

11895.info_text: Dancing Stage EuroMIX is in this establishment as well as the other games you come to expect.

11896.info_text: Not a particularly great location. The single machine with screen burn in on the left hand side of the screen. Pads give misses and crap every so often. Usually has sand all over the pads. Fairly easy to find, just inside of the middle doors.

11898.info_text: All sessions are 3 hours maximum / £14.50 for Adult session / £14.00 for Student session (NUS card required) / £10.50 for Child session (5-15yr) / Free for under 5 Yrs old / £46.00 for Family Session / Either: / - 2 Adults & 2 Children / - 1 Adult & 3 Children / Carers get free ticket with purchase of full-paying admission ticket

11899.info_text: Airsoft place that also has an arcade. It's £10 for two hours. / Games unlisted - / Three different MAME cabinets, one of which is a Pandora's Box. These all work fine / 4 PS4 setups for racing games with F1-style wheels. From what I can tell, they have the systems linked. / Air hockey table and pool table. / Three pinball machines - I have completely forgotten the names, but they work fine from what I can tell / Tuesdays to Fridays are by booking only

11900.info_text: Jubeat, Pump It Up, Project Diva and Crossbeats coming soon!

11901.info_text: Small arcade Owned by HB Leisure.

11903.info_text: Energetic hangout featuring craft beer, burgers, an arcade, escape room & remote-control cars. / Brighton Stock smash bros events are done here bi-weekly too! / All Machines are upstairs

11904.info_text: 1 of two Thomas' Centres in hunstanton - the other being just across the car park.

11906.info_text: With a few arcade games, mainly Raw Thrills. / This park is open seasonally.

11907.info_text: The golden age of Arcade gaming has returned to Bridgwater, Somerset! (UK) / Open every weekend, pay once to get in - Play all day with unlimited credits on 30+ arcade machines, pool tables and more. / Light snacks and drinks are available to purchase. / **Updated September 2018** Machines Still There :-) Working Great !

11909.info_text: There are quite a lot of redemption games, coin pushers and claw machines here.

11910.info_text: Bar with a focus on football simulations. / The bar contains 6 arcade cabinets running the PlayStation 3 version of FIFA 08, converted into an arcade cabinet. The arcade cabinets are totally free to use and entry is also free. However all the cabinets are often in use. / The cabinets are: / *2 on the ground floor, main area / *2 on the ground floor, "Boxes 7-13" area / *1 on the upper floor, public area / *1 on the upper floor in the VIP area / They appear to be custom built cabinets, as they just display the AOC logo (gaming monitor) on boot, followed by the PS3 menu. There are no other games installed on the PS3 except FIFA 08 itself which is running from disc.

11911.info_text: Just opened, games are ran by Namco, uses a payment card system with bulk discounts starting at £15 / Has a couple of prize games and air hockey games in addition to the regular games / £5 = 20 credits / £10 = 40 credits / £15 = 80 credits / £20 = 110 credits / £25 = 140 credits / £50 = 320 credits

11912.info_text: An arcade in Totton, Southampton that operates on sessions. (I.e., you book a certain time period to come play, and all machines are set to free play.) / Sessions are £8.99 for 50 minutes, though you can book multiple sessions in a row for extended periods. / Bookings are quite limited, as there seems to be a maximum of 15 people per session (according to the booking site at least). / They have a decent mix of modern and retro machines. / Times are as shown, but on school holidays (and bank holidays), they are open every day.

11914.info_text: "Family fun park" with its own entry fee on top of the cost of games / Has a multi-room arcade labelled "Edwardian penny arcade" (or something similar), lots of the sega games have been removed recently, but it might still be worth a visit / Most recent video I can find of it: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L3igU9a2DXw

machine_prices.ddr: £1 / 2 songs Standard Mode / £1 / 2 songs Doubles Mode

11917.info_text: Quite a strange arcade, its like an arcade warehouse of random machines, fake grass floor around most of the arcade and carpet around back. There is a lot of small kids rides and redemption machines, too many to count. / Around the front extension part theres mostly 2p/5p/10p machines with a bunch of random machines, kids rides and EuroMix2. / Further in the back of the extension is Guitar Hero and EuroMix1 and more random machines, please note that with the stairs around there, the bottom of the stairs are liable to flooding (im not joking) so be careful. / Up the stairs you will find a bunch of racing games in the corner, more 2p machines and A3, actual carpet around here! / Rest of the arcade is mostly redemption, shooter, hamster wheel, etc.

11920.info_text: Arcade accessable to non-residents. Small parking area in front of it too. Not open in winter. Large arcade and all the typical holiday park fayre available.

machine_prices.ddr: 15 Credits/Bonus / 3 songs Singles / 30 Credits/Bonus / 3 songs Versus / 30 Credits/Bonus / 3 songs Doubles

11923.info_text: Urban fun runs on a credit and Bonus credit system / credits can be used on any machine / bonus credits can be used on any machines that don't give a reward (have a yellow scanner) / £10 gets you 100 credits / £20 gets you 200 credits + 50 bonus credits / £30 gets you 300 credits + 100 bonus credits / £50 gets you 500 credits + 250 bonus credits / Machine issues (like a snapped DDR panel) are usually fixed quickly during the day once informed.

11924.info_text: Has VR games and a arcade, manned by Sega.

11926.info_text: Unsure of anything about this place, as I haven't visited. I'm going to add the games seen on their Facebook page, but I can't confirm whether these will be there or not. / Email: Warroomlasertag@gmail.com / Other Opening Times: / SCHOOL HOLIDAYS: / Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday – Private Hire Only / Friday 11:00am – 22:30pm / Saturday 11:00am – 22:30pm / Sunday 11:00am – 17:00pm / Closed Christmas Day, Boxing Day and New Years Day.

11928.info_text: Also a holiday resort. Arcade part is quite small but is open 24/7.

11929.info_text: This is a arcade nearest to the Pontins site. / Not many games here, but only added it because Youtuber McPizzaPerson has visited this place.

11930.info_text: Located behind Wellington Peir. / From pics on website seems a small selection of arcade cabs.

11931.info_text: The machines here are set up so they are right next to each other. Both have full attract volume on, and one is not quiet when the other is playing.

11932.info_text: Formerly operated by Sega, but from 2020 the whole arcade is now operated by by HB Leisure. Still opening hours.

11933.info_text: Has a fairly large arcade area for a not so big bowling alley. Many new games such as the Pac Man smash thing. Cafe, bar and kids play area. As of May 2018, they have become a Sega game zone. DDR X gone...Sonic statue present instead.

11935.info_text: Newly fefurbished arcade, after being taken over by large caravan park.

11936.info_text: This is a new bowling alley in Woking, owned by the same group as Wokingham Superbowl.

11937.info_text: Their games have expanded slightly. Might be worth a go.

11938.info_text: One of the only arcades in the West Midlands to include a Dark Escape 4D machine and a Deadstorm Pirates Speical Editon machine! / The arcade used to have DDR Euromix 2 machine; this was eventually taken away because of the state it was in and was replaced with a biking machine. / Bar is on the left upon entering the area. / Arcade machines are straight upon entering the area. / Where the arcade machines are, turning right will lead to the bowling area.

11939.info_text: While this is mostly a theme park/falconry, there is an arcade upstairs in the "sea dragon" and other soft indoor play areas.

11941.info_text: No rhythm games to speak of, but has a nice collection of arcade games, all of which are 50p a play! / All games also specify if they accept the new £1 coin or not.

11942.info_text: Pub with a few games and gamblers scattered around / All the games have readers for contactless card payment, and prices are pretty good with £1 generally giving multiple credits

11944.info_text: With a rotating collection of the best arcade games ever made, 2ND LOOP transports you to the golden age of gaming with hidden gems by SEGA, CAVE, CAPCOM, and more. Plus, discover MaiMai DX, LA's best selection of gashapon, and fighting game meetups every day of the week. / This is the return of the neighborhood arcade. This is the 2ND LOOP.

11945.info_text: Absolutely massive family entertainment center located in the former Sears space at the Fort Steuben Mall. Features over a hundred different arcade cabinets, multiple lanes of bowling, axe throwing, cornhole, a full service restaurant with an outdoor patio, live music, indoor blacklight mini golf, and more. / All games take game cards. Game cards can be purchased and refilled at both kiosks and the counter, but they occasionally have special offers that can be redeemed only at the counter (for example, during July on Thursdays, if you purchase a $55 game card from the counter, you will receive a voucher for a free pizza at the restaurant). / Current game card pricing as of July 2025; / $22 - 100 credits / $44 - 225 credits (optional $6 upcharge for an additional 35 credits) / $55 - 300 credits (optional $7 upcharge for an additional 55 credits) / $66 - 400 credits (optional $8 upcharge for an additional 70 credits) / $80 - 550 credits (optional $10 upcharge for an additional 80 credits) / $110 - 780 credits (optional $12 upcharge for an additional 125 credits)

11946.info_text: A brewery with an arcade. No machines are online.

11947.info_text: Billiards, games and GREAT food. THAT'S what Eight On The Break is all about! 3 Brunswick Gold Crown Regulation Tables, over 50 great games (classic and new) and some of the best playing pinballs ANYWHERE! / For 50 years we have provided the Northern New Jersey area with the best in family entertainment. / Please come and enjoy "The Break" I think you will find this unusual different family fun center has everything you could ever want. / The Story: / Eight On the Break was founded by Edward Montross in 1973. Ed was WAY far ahead of his time. Many years later a new generation (me) would take his concept and run with it! The Family Fun Center was born! / "The Break" was primarily a "pool hall" at that time but it was the very first place to have the new fangled "TV games". 8OTB has fuzzy wallpaper (still here from the 1970's) shag carpet and paintings on the walls. / It feels like home! / In 1986 my company American Family Fun Centers purchased 8OTB from Mr. Montross. The late 80's saw many changes with a strong focus on video games. It was our ability to change with the times and adopt new ideas that has kept 8OTB alive. / First came the fighting games then the dancing/music gam...

11948.info_text: THIS IS NOT A PUBLIC ARCADE. The venue is available for rental ONLY, according to the site. / "We are a premier curated boutique arcade that provides in-person private rental experiences, birthday parties, and private photo shoots. Night City also provides a travelling arcade that services conventions, trade shows, corporate events, parties, and other private events." / Arcade Rental Rates as of March 3, 2025: / 1 Person: $25 / Hour / 2-5 People: $50 / Hour / 6-10 People: $75 / Hour / 11 - 15 People: $100 / Hour / 16 - 20 People: $125 / Hour / They accept bookings via their website.

11949.info_text: Small arcade located on the 1st floor (near Macy's) of the Monroeville Mall just outside of Pittsburgh. The mall is slated for demoltiion in 2027, but as of January 2026 the arcade is still open. All games take quarters, and there is a change machine on site.

11950.info_text: (9/14/22) 1 DDR Extreme Machine / .50 for 3 songs / The volume is low / The UP Arrow on the Left Pad is very sporadic / The Right Pad is good but doesn't work as well as it should. // / Old info: / In The Groove 2 (Hacked): / - $.50 / 3 songs, Doubles Premium / - Upgraded DDR machine, pads are good for an upgrade, decent volume, doubles premium, hacked with ITG3, Rebirth, MGD 1/2/3, DDR 1st mix through X, tournament packs, and other various songs. This is a test location for OpenITG and is currently running a development build of OpenITG beta 3.

11951.info_text: Up on the second floor at the end of one of the branches in the mall, right by the Sears. There are some chairs and two couches right outside the arcade. There's also an Auntie Ann's pretzels a bit down the strip that sells bottled water for $1.50 a bottle. Come prepared, there is no nearby water fountain. Their coin changer only takes $1 and $5 bills.

11952.info_text: Great place for family and friends! There is also skating and laser tag. / Arcade is horrible. Left player pad barely works. Right side is a little better, but lowers scores by almost one letter grade. :( / Winter Season Hours: / Sun - Thurs: noon - 9 PM / Fri: noon - 11 PM / Sat: 10am - 11 PM

11953.info_text: DDR Extreme cabinet / - / Both pads work well, able to pass Legend Road. Operators are nice and have replaced bad sensors in the past. Hidden songs are unlocked, highscores aren't enabled though.

11954.info_text: Candlepin bowling alley with an arcade and a selection of pinball machines.

11956.info_text: The multi-sport complex includes an NHL-regulated sized ice rink, 8 basketball courts (convertible to 16 volleyball/pickleball courts), a 40,000 sq. ft. turf field, locker rooms, training area, café, bar and grill, and more. / Our family entertainment center, Hawk’s Outpost, is home to arcade games, bowling, laser tag, an esports center, sports simulators, and a roll glider.

11958.info_text: DDR is finally back and this Extreme cab is WAY better than the Supernova 2 they had before. The pads are as close to perfect as you can get for a public Extreme cab. Also, this one takes tokens, so it's way cheaper than the $1 price of Supernova. / They have daily specials, so prices vary wildly. The cheapest option is 200 for $20 on Wednesday, which comes out to 20 cents per game. / It's mostly a place for children and families, so if you can avoid coming during the day on weekends as there's usually lots of kids. It's pretty peaceful on weeknights, though.

11959.info_text: This location has go-karts, minigolf, laser tag, batting cages and a large arcade. They are now card-based and the base price is $5 for 20 credits, but you can get better deals on the card kiosk (such as $30 for 150 credits (plus 30 bonus)). / This place gets a lot of kids during the day. Also for those of you that love giraffes (like my wife), the minigolf course is full of life-size giraffes.

11960.info_text: Located just off Interstate 95 at the FL-16 exit, this arcade is close by with other things like Go-Kart and others to do. Haven't checked out the whole place yet but the DDR there is awful, and the only real option for music games in St. Augustine unless I am wrong somehow.

11961.info_text: *As of May 2, 2026, the only known locations with rhythm games in Louisiana are: / -Adventure Quest Laser Tag | New Orleans | DDR SuperNOVA | PUBLIC / -Big Easy Social | New Orleans | Dance Central 3 | PUBLIC / -Dave & Busters Lafayette | Lafayette | Pump It Up XX | PUBLIC / -Dave & Busters New Orleans | New Orleans | Pump It Up XX | PUBLIC / -Game On Social Hub | New Orleans (Kenner Area) | Guitar Hero | PUBLIC / -Main Event | Baton Rouge | Beat Saber | Pump It Up XX | PUBLIC / -Otherworlds' Arcade | New Orleans (Kenner Area) | Wacca Reverse | CHUNITHUM Paradise Lost | PUBLIC / -Wayback's Arcade | Alexandria (Pineville Area) | CHUNITHUM Paradise Lost | DDR SuperNOVA 2 | Guitar Hero | jubeat Ave. | pop'n music Unilab | Pump It Up PRIME | Sound Voltex Exceed Gear | Wacca Reverse | PUBLIC / ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- / Their hours change frequently, so it's best to check their website for the most accurate hours.

11963.info_text: This location used to be Carnival Thrillz in Canal Park here in Duluth. We first got this machine in early 2007 as a replacement for a bootleg Extreme machine (I have no idea where that went) at the Miller Hill Mall location, brand new from what I can recall. The Mall location has closed, and the machine has since been moved to this location. / They never host any DDR-related events, and seem to have no interest in upgrading the machine to any later version. :( / As of 2016 they switched from tokens to an Embed card system. Cards can be purchased at the main counter or at a kiosk. Prices for the games are still the same.

11964.info_text: Circus Circus Las Vegas' Indoor Theme Park. Has free entry, but all the rides take a wristband to get on. There used to be a retro pay for hourly arcade near where the chaos used to be which included some DDR and PIU but sadly is now defunct.

machine_prices.ddr: Token based, Tokens relative to arcade.

11967.info_text: Opened 9/22/25. / Akiba House is an anime & manga collectables store. This is their second location here in NYC, their fifth location nationwide, and the first to feature arcade games. / The arcade is located along the right wall in the back of the store. Tokens for each arcade game can be purchased for $1 each. Make sure to specify you want tokens for the arcade games, because they also have different tokens for the gashapon machines, and the two are not compatible with each other.

machine_prices.ddr: $1 / 3 songs STANDARD MODE / $1 / 3 songs PREMIUM MODE / Double Premium is not on / Flat screw mod
machine_prices.jubeat: US$0.50 for 3 songs / US$0.50 to continue
machine_prices.maimai_dx: US$1.00 for 3 songs / US$1.00 to continue
machine_prices.reflec: US$0.50 for 3 songs / US$0.50 to continue
machine_prices.taiko: $1.00 USD for 3 songs if only 1 player / $2.00 USD for 3 songs if 2 players

11968.info_text: Arcade and bar. / Most cabinets are candy cabs

11969.info_text: Akihabara is a unique spin on the bar & arcade idea, featuring almost every music game under the sun, as well as japanese candy cabs and retro games. They also have a console gaming lounge with tournaments. / Up-to-date game list at: https://www.akihabaraarcade.com/gamelist / Admission is limited to those over 21-years of age after 21:00.

11970.info_text: THIS IS A PRIVATE ARCADE AT MY HOUSE!! / If you would like to come over and play please DM me on Twitter or join my Discord. I am only allowing special events at this time for games. / https://twitter.com/OMG_KON / https://discord.gg/CuxZRaDhGj / Arcade events are announced in Discord under the #akihabara-arcade channel.

11971.info_text: Inside the Alley 51 International Street Market adjacent to Super G Pineville. / Satellite location of Super Abari Game Bar in Charlotte, but uses different tokens.

11972.info_text: Upscale movie theater with a small arcade at the entrance. Movie tickets not required to access arcade and arcade uses a proprietary card system for credits.

11977.info_text: *As of May 2, 2026, the only known locations with rhythm games in this state are: / -Margaritaville Resort | Biloxi | PIU Infinity | StepManiaX | PUBLIC / -Games, Inc. (Edgewater Mall) | Biloxi | StepMania Simply Love | PUBLIC / -Big Play | Biloxi | Beat Saber | Guitar Hero | PUBLIC / -Allin1 Adventures | Meridian | StepManiaX | PUBLIC / -Games, Inc. (Turtle Creek Mall) | Hattiesburg | StepManiaX | PUBLIC / -Cici's Pizza | Southaven | StepManiaX | PUBLIC / -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

11978.info_text: Indoor trampoline park and ninja course that also has a selection of arcade games and redemption games placed around the main floor. All games operate on an Intercard game card system, current pricing is as follows: / $10 - 40 credits (25¢ per credit) / $25 - 120 credits (~21¢ per credit) / $50 - 260 credits (~19.2¢ per credit) / $75 - 400 credits (~18.8¢ per credit) / $100 - 540 credits (~18.5¢ per credit)

11980.info_text: [b]This is a movie theater location with the following rules in effect[/b] / Outside food or drink are not permitted. Concessions are available. / Box office ticket is not required for purchase. / This arcade uses Tokens. (Namco 900) / [b]Token rates[/b] / $1.00 = 4 tokens / $5.00 = 20 tokens / $10.00 = 40 tokens / $20.00 = 80 tokens

11981.info_text: Uses a points card system for the arcades / $5 | 125pts / $10 | 250pts / $25 | 938pts (625pts+313bonus) / $50 | 1875pts (1250pts+625bonus) / $100 | 3750pts (2500pts+1250bonus)

11984.info_text: Indoor karting facility with an attached arcade. Very focused on VR and simulators, with prices to match.

11985.info_text: Indoor go-kart facility with bowling and arcade available.

machine_prices.ddr: $1.00 if you have a monthly VIP pass / $1.25 in all other cases

11988.info_text: Andy B's: / -Bowling / -Go Karts / -Arcade - Uses cards instead of tokens / -Laser Tag (Coming soon!)

11989.info_text: Used to have DDR and Guitar Hero until Hurricane Matthew. They recently got Guitar Hero again, though it seems that they cycle through different arcade machines. A few years back they had the Game of Thrones pinball, and in now (2022) they have The Munsters.

11990.info_text: Dedicated arcade adjacent to the Edmonds store. Enjoy arcade cabinets, pinball machines, tournaments, late hours, snacks and beer. / Here's a thread from PNWBemani.net discussing this location: / http://www.pnwbemani.net/western-wa/(arcade)-another-castle-video-games-edmonds-wa/

11991.info_text: Indoor complex featuring an arcade, bar, restaurant, go-karts, mini golf, bowling, a ropes course, sports simulators, trampoline park, axe throwing, a rage room, and even a Planet Fitness. The arcade section is located downstairs from the main entrance. All games take reloadable game cards.

11992.info_text: Family Entertainment center with Bowling, Go-Karts, Axe Throwing, and an arcade

11993.hours_text: Mon-Thu closed; Fri 17:30-21:30; Sat 16:00-00:00; Sun closed
11993.info_text: Arcade that runs on a pay what you can model. Primarily focused on fighting games but is offering more rhythm gaming over time.

11994.info_text: An arcade in Flower Mound, TX that specializes in older games, but still has games from many different video game generations. There is a $12 dollar admission fee, but after that, all of the games are set to free play. Food and Drink is available, as well as a few tables to sit by.

11995.info_text: An arcade in McKinney, TX that specializes in older games, but still has games from many different video game generations. There is a $12 dollar admission fee, but after that, all of the games are set to free play. Food and Drink is available, as well as a few tables to sit by.

11996.info_text: A 501(c)(3) nonprofit pinball & arcade museum featuring 50+ pinball and arcade games, as well as imported Japanese rhythm games. $20 for all day play or $13 for a sampler pass.

11997.info_text: New Arcade that recently opened in late 2022.

11998.info_text: Arcade opened on summer 2025 in Route D storages 356, 357, 456, and 457 at the back. $1 for parking and 1$ for extra visitor.

12000.info_text: Arcade Galactic specializes in rare and arcade exclusives that you won't find on any console, in any other arcade in Utah. Possibly the entire region. A few games you won't even find in the rest of the country! / The owners run a well-known and wonderful website which focuses on everything arcade gaming, and then some. http://arcadeheroes.com/ / The Game Grid is inside the Valley Fair Mall. Just off of I-215 and 3500 South. It is in the North end, just across from The Nerd Store. / There is now a 2nd location in Ogden inside Newgate Mall

12001.info_text: Across from Cracker Barrel and Thornton’s directly off the I-75 Sharonville Road exit. / Has a dedicated media store to buy, sell, and trade in. / All games are on free play except for premium pinball. / Headphones are highly encouraged/recommended for the games! / It can get quite loud during peak hours and drown out the cabs. / Pricing: / $5 One Hour / $10 All Day / $50 Monthly Pass. Lasts 30 days from date of purchase. / $500 Yearly Pass. Lasts 365 days from date of purchase. / Premium pinball is 50 cents per play. / No admission is required if you would only like to visit the bar & restaurant or the premium pinball area.

12003.info_text: The largest arcade in Orlando. Pay a one entry fee to play as long as you want. All games are on Free Play. / Recently ended up becoming an arcade that operates 24 hours a day as of March 21st, 2026 / $24.99 All Day Unlimited Play (+ Re-Entry Access) / $19.99 All Day Unlimited Play (No Re-Entry). Admission for Cosplay, Family, Military, and First Responder

12004.info_text: A cozy lounge arcade filled with the greatest arcade games in the Lake Mary area. All games are unlimited free-to-play. / $15 All Day No Re-Entry / $20 All Day + Re-Entry / 15% Off for Cosplay, Family, Military, and First Responder / Has lots of bartop console game stations (Nintendo Switch)

12005.info_text: (IMPORTANT NOTE, Arcade Monsters Lido HAS REOPENED! Message from their instagram, “ We’re Back, Lido Beach Arcade Monsters! 🌊 / After being hit by two hurricanes in just a few weeks, we’ve been working around the clock to get back on our feet. We’re excited to announce that we’re re-opening today, October 19th, 5 PM - 12 AM! 🎉 / Our doors will be open from 12 PM to midnight everyday moving forward, and we could really use your support now more than ever while we continue to work towards full capacity everyday. About 80% of our games are up and running on both floors. The second floor is fully operational as we’ve swapped the games from our warehouse and the first is about 80% done. We’ve been working hard removing water logged games and swapping them out with new games. We were fully underwater, but we will never let anything stop us. 12163.info_text: The traditional pizza rat experience! Lots of low-value ticket games, kids high as your knees running around every which way, a salad bar that you don't want to touch unless you're looking to develop new and undiscovered diseases, an underpaid teenager walking around in the mascot costume for five minutes on the hour every hour. Now with brand new "2.0" experiences like a large TV instead of animatronics, a digital dancefloor, a trampoline zone, and a mini ninja warrior course. Oh yeah, and some of the blandest undercooked pizza you'll ever taste in your life, with what feels like a pound of salt dumped directly on top. It's Chuck E. Cheese, where a kid can be a kid! / All games here take game cards, which either can be loaded with points or time play. The only exception is the giant claw machine, which only takes money or credit cards.

12187.info_text: Cinemark Imax Tulsa / Arcade is located in the Cinemark portion, to the left as you walk in.

12188.info_text: Formerly "Cinemark Festival Bay and XD" and "Cinemark Artegon Marketplace and XD", the movie theatre was undisturbed by the mall's transformation into Dezerland. Arcade is to the left of the ticket taker. All games take tokens, 4 tokens to $1 with no bulk discount, with the exception of the Kiddleton claw machines which take their own specialized tokens at $1 apiece. / No posted hours; check the website for the most up-to-date showtimes.

12191.info_text: [b]This is a movie theater location with the following rules in place:[/b] / - No outside food or drink permitted. Movie theater concessions are available. / - Box Office Ticket purchase is not required to gain access to arcade. / - Change will not be given for large bills / - Play at your own risk, theater management does not reimburse for coin door stolen tokens. / [b]This arcade uses tokens to play the games[/b] / $1.00 for 4 tokens / $5.00 for 25 tokens (5 free) / $10's and higher bills cannot be used at their token machines.

12192.info_text: All games run on game cards.

12193.info_text: Modern renovated bowling alley with a moderately sized arcade attached. All arcade games take game cards with value stored in dollar amounts; unlike many other locations, you do not get bonus credits on your card for loading higher value amounts to your card. However, every Tuesday they have "Arcade Happy Hour" which offers half priced games all day long, which may be your best bet given the high per-game prices they have here. / Has a sister location in Piscataway at the home of the former Stelton Lanes.

12194.info_text: Upscale bowling alley located inside the former Stelton Lanes building. Has a decent sized arcade with several dozen games, as well as a pool table and two pinball machines in the bar area. All games take reloadable Intercard game cards. Credit exchange rate is approximately 33¢ per credit, variable rate upon how much you load at a time. They offer half-off games during Tuesday nights, so for example, a 5 credit game will drop down to 2.5 credits instead.

12195.info_text: Small barcade with bowling, food, drinks on tap, and a surprising amount of mostly older cabinets/reproductions.

12196.info_text: Bar and arcade, anyone under 21 is asked to leave past 9 PM. Uses tap to play cards

12197.info_text: Located in the Paul Bunyan Mall. The DDR there is maintained by a manager there and is in great condition.

12198.info_text: Sports bar and bowling alley with some arcade games

12200.info_text: Brand new mall arcade on the basement/concourse floor of the Roosevelt Field Mall in Garden City, Long Island, NY. Operates with about a 50/50 split of claw machines and a mix of other games including redemption, video, VR, and pinball. Opened to the public September 16th, 2024. / All games take game cards. Current pricing is as follows; / $15 - 60 credits (25¢/credit) / $25 - 110 credits (22.7¢/credit) / $35 - 164 credits (21.3¢/credit) / $50 - 240 credits (20.8¢/credit) / $100 - 500 credits (20¢/credit) / $200 - 1050 credits (19¢/credit) / They also additionally offer timed unlimited video play cards; these will not work on cranes, other prize merchandising games, VR games, or photo booths. Pricing for those is as follows: / $11.95 - 30 minutes / $19.95 - 60 minutes / $24.95 - 90 minutes / $29.95 - 120 minutes / Last but not least, they also offer a monthly membership at $34.95 per month, which gives you access to member pricing on all games (10% discount), a weekly $10 game card, a 10% discount on birthday parties, and an additional $25 game card for signing up. This renews on a monthly basis but there is no long-term commitment and you can cancel at any time. They also claim...

12204.info_text: Arcade across from Viejas Bowl in the Viejas Outlet Center. 12205.info_text: Facing the box office of the theater, the entrances are on the left and you can clearly see the arcade machine from the outside. A machine to change dollars into coins is on the right upon entering. / The machine is upgraded from a SuperNova machine. The machine is fully unlocked and the pads are responsive. The bar for Player 2 is [i]very[/i] wobbly. The bar for Player 1 is not as bad as Player 2. / The place can get pretty packed on weekends and people tend to take advantage of the crowd to steal things so be cautious on where you place your accessories. / The employees are nice. The owner tends to upgrade the machine as soon as possible when there's a new release. / Machine unlocked by silenttype01 and Lord Toon

12206.info_text: DanceDanceRevolution Extreme / - 1 token ($0.25) per credit (3 songs) / - Cab pads in GOOD condition; machine volume ACCEPTABLE (venue sound system/noise increases significantly after 8pm making play untenable) / - Cab located at the back of space, around the corner near bathrooms.

12208.info_text: A bar/ arcade with a variety of classic games. Most of their games are in great condition, but the customers and the music that the bar plays can be really loud, often too loud to be able to hear the game you're playing, which is especially annoying if you're playing DDR. / Since it is a bar, you need an ID to confirm with the bouncer that you are at least 21 years old to get in. / According to the staff, closing times are flexible depending on how much business there is on a particular night. They've had last calls as early as 11pm, so come before then if you're looking to play late at night.

12209.info_text: A basement barcade with a courtyard, that currently has 40+ arcade games ranging from 1981-82 releases Donkey Kong and Tron to the 2011 4-Player Pac-Man Battle Royale. About half of the floor is dedicated to games from the 80’s and early 90’s. They also have a full bar that serves both cocktails and local craft beer, as well as other foods. / * [b]Admission limited to those age 21 and over[/b] / * Payment: Quarters only, coin machines and ATM are available. / * Games are set to free-play on Sundays.

12210.info_text: Completely renovated Family Fun Center with Bowling, Laser Tag, and a full bar and restaurant plus snack bar. Hours may vary, so call ahead to confirm. / Games are half-price on Fridays from 4-6pm.

12211.info_text: Colony Park is a 28-lane bowling alley that offers regular and glow bowling, and often hosts bowling tournaments and birthday parties. Their arcade has recently been renovated as of December 2023, and as of February 2024, has a StepManiaX Deluxe cabinet. Located right next to the York campus of Harrisburg Area Community College.

12214.info_text: Arcade, mini golf, movie theater, go-karts, bumper cars, climbing walls, batting cages, a restaurant/bar all in one place.

12215.info_text: DM on Twitch or other social media for address (joining my Discord might be easiest: https://discord.gg/EXKgzJaEgS ) / https://twitch.tv/picante / Mostly open on weekends.

12216.info_text: Hours vary depending on season (During summer vacation, spring break, etc. they close at 10 PM instead of 9 on the weekdays). Currently closed Mondays. Purchase of a buffet or a $10 game card is required for admission. / All games and attractions use a swipe card, you can purchase one as you enter or in the game room. Reloadable. / ITG2 can be found by entering the main arcade area, go left toward the back, and it will be against the wall to the right. In The Groove 2 is hacked to include ITG3, ITG Rebirth, all DDR arcade mixes, and a bunch of custom songs. USB cards and custom song playback enabled. OpenITG updated to latest revision, MEMORY CARDS AND CUSTOMS WORKING 100% NOW! Also, I uploaded a ton of customs to the hard drive, including most customs tracked by GrooveStats. Please note that IPC is a family-oriented establishment; please do not play customs with inappropriate language! / If you have any issues with the machine (arrows sticking, customs not working etc.) ask the attendant on duty to leave a note for Kevin, the head technician.

There is also a separate free play room that requires the purchase of a wristband for $10, which grants you all-day entry and exit privileges. As of January 2026, the DDR cab is located inside the free play room. / Hours listed below are their fall & winter hours; check the Facebook page for any updates. If a game only lists a price in credits, it does not accept payment via credit card. On average, one credit equates to 25¢.

12506.info_text: Indoor family entertainment center located at the Sully Station Shopping Center strip mall. Owned and operated by the Five Star Parks & Attractions group. Features go-karts, laser tag, a ropes course, Clip-n-Climb walls, and a large amount of arcade games (mostly of the redemption game variety). All attractions including the games use a game card for payment; this card works exclusively at this location and credits do not transfer from the Fredericksburg location. / Game cards are available in the following denominations; / $25 - 110 chips (22.7¢ per chip) / $50 - 230 chips (21.7¢ per chip) / $75 - 360 chips (20.8¢ per chip) / $100 - 500 chips (20¢ per chip) / $150 - 750 chips (20¢ per chip) / Additionally, they also offer a Day Pass for $46.99 which includes access to all the attractions except for VR, and allows play on all arcade games with the caveat that games will not award chips, tickets, credits, or prizes. / On Wednesdays, all game prices are half-off (ie, a game that typically costs 4.0 chips to play will have its swiper cost reduced to 2.0 chips).

12507.info_text: Indoor/outdoor family entertainment center located in Fredericksburg, VA. In addition to a large arcade game floor, they also have a go-kart track, roller coaster, ropes course, rock climbing wall, and a number of other amusement park rides. All games and attractions take credits loaded onto a game card. They have a sister location in Fairfax, but the game cards do not work between the two locations. / They offer two versions of a season pass; the entry level gives you unlimited access to the attractions and member pricing for the arcade games. The plus level gives you unlimited non-redemption games (including their rhythm games as well as racers and shooters), so if you're the sort of person that will go there just to grind out games, this may be an option for you. / Hours vary on a weekly basis; check the website before you go for the most up-to-date hours.

12508.info_text: Dance games are bad not for more serious players. Occasionally hours change; check http://www.fun-n-stuff.com/calendarofevents_000.html for most recent updates.

12509.info_text: This arcade is inside the Grand Sierra Resort at the Spa floor. If coming in from the casino, please use elevator/escalator down.

12510.info_text: Store Tour: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=I7o3U63jAHU / This Location has a PIU LX

12511.info_text: Fun Spot is a chain of arcades owned by Chuck E Cheese focused on the arcade only & plans to be based in malls all over the US. In The Trumbull Mall, you can find the arcade downstairs next to Champs. Current staff is really friendly from experience! The machine maintainer is not there everyday due to driving to several Chuck E Cheese owned locations around the north east, so catching them might be hard if there is anything that needs maintaining. / I still highly recommending this arcade either if your a casual arcade gamer or a Pump It Up player.

12512.info_text: Unassumingly tucked away in a Staten Island strip mall, this is a decently large family entertainment center featuring lots of redemption games, indoor amusement park rides, a kiddie play area, laser tag, batting cages, a basketball court, and more. Depending upon when you visit, the extra attractions may not be open due to staffing issues. The games themselves are always on during all operating hours. / All games operate on the Intercard system. You can purchase game cards at kiosks next to the front counter. / There used to be another Fun Station USA location on Long Island as well, but that location has since closed and the only one remaining is the Staten Island center.

12513.info_text: Times listed are summer hours. Only open weekends in the winter.

12514.info_text: This is Fun Zone Arcade's Folsom Outlet Mall location. / [b]Music Games:[/b] StepMania, StepManiaX, Pump It Up: Phoenix, and Dancerush Stardom / [b]Payment:[/b] Sells game cards for $2.00 from the kiosk to the right of the entrance. Credits are a nickel each, and can only be bought 50 credits at a time with discounts if you buy in bulk at $15.00 or more. You can use any card from an arcade that uses Amusement Connect, but only credits bought from that kiosk will work on games. Credits work at all locations. / [b]History:[/b] Fun Zone USA is a small but modern arcade chain located in Northern California. This is its first location. Opened on 1/1/2023, it's run by the same people who offer arcade games to several bowling alleys in the area. They aim to be a place the big guys are not. They renamed themselves to Fun Zone USA on 3/15/2026

12515.info_text: This is the Konocti Vista Casino Resort's arcade. Includes a sports bar and Little Caesar's Express. Enter through the doors on the left of the main entrance and continue forward to enter the arcade. / Music Games: StepManiaX. / Pricing: Most games cost $1 to play (crane games cost $2 and VR cost $5) and use a game card that is exclusive to this arcade. / Cards from other arcades in the area with similar names don't work at this location. / [b]Help desk times as of May 2026:[/b] / Monday - Thursday: Unavailable / Thursday: 11:00 - 20:00 / Friday - Saturday: 11:00 - 00:00 / Sunday: 11:00 - 20:00 / Opening Times as of May 2026.

12516.info_text: Classic old-school arcade with an diner-like snack bar. Open from 7:30 AM until 11:00 PM every day of the week, though be aware that this location is closed during the off-season (November through February).

12518.info_text: Open seasonally, there is a second arcade in same building, some games may be there.

12519.info_text: Joint bounce house + arcade. / You'd have to pay for entry, and also pay for an arcade card as well. / Better to visit during the weekdays, weekends are very active and can be chaotic. / Outside food is not allowed (individual bottles/water jugs are okay). The store is partnered with Blaze Pizza and Charleys for food service, which can be purchased directly at Cosmo's Prize HQ. / As of Early June 2026, the arcade pricing structure has changed - arcade games now range from 13 - 18 credits.

12521.info_text: Half ice cream parlor, half modern arcade. While some arcades offer half-price games on certain days of the week, this might be the only place to offer buy-one-get-one-free ice cream on Thursdays and Sundays! / All games take game cards. Current game card and credit pricing is as follows; / $10 - 20 credits (50¢/credit) / $25 - 55 credits (~45¢/credit) / $50 - 115 credits (~43¢/credit) / $75 - 175 credits (~42¢/credit) / $100 - 240 credits (~41¢/credit)

12524.info_text: Seaside Outlet location is now open! https://www.seasideoutlets.com/stores / Funtastic's Seaside location mostly features crane games and racing games with some shooters and sports-themed games. It seems to be run without staff for most of the time, so any concerns with the games/arcade may not be quickly addressed. Note that for crane games, you cannot win any prizes in-person, but instead prizes are mailed out to you. / Game cards can be purchased and refilled via either of the two kiosks near the front of the arcade. Kiosks do not return any change.

12525.info_text: Waterpark, Mini Golf, and an arcade, amongst other things. Used to have a SuperNova cabinet (had it from 2006-2018), but it broke and was donated to a community member. Arcade area is dark and ridiculously loud; during the summers come during nights, for the other three seasons come in the mornings/afternoons. / Arcade uses a card system. Games are cheap, prizes are bad.

12526.info_text: Swipe cards like Round1, Main Event, and Dave & Buster's

12527.info_text: Newer arcade in the mall that's been open for a few months. Pretty small but charming if you like skeeball :3 / Credit “Packages”: (These come with a card) / $25 - 120 Credits / $50 - 300 Credits / $100 - 720 Credits / New Card Activation Fee: 4.8 Credits (4.8 Credits = $1, so you’re not losing too much..) / (please correct if ANY of this is wrong!!)

12529.info_text: Summer hours (Memorial Day to Labor Day) posted above. / School Year hours (Labor Day to Memorial Day) below: / Mon. - Thurs. : 10AM - 9PM / Friday & Saturday: 10AM - Midnight / Sunday: 10AM - 10 PM

12530.info_text: Massive tri-level arcade and family entertainment center inside of a gigantic castle located in Nashua, NH, just over the Massachusetts state line. The first floor is mostly redemption games and kid's games, and also features a reasonably priced snack bar. The second floor has modern arcade games alongside classics and rarities from the 90's and 2000's, as well as three rides including a double-decker carousel, Himalaya, and roller coaster. The third floor is currently more sparsely populated but contains a small selection of pinball machines and rhythm games. / All games operate via tokens. Tokens can be purchased with cash at any of the change machines located throughout the building, or with credit cards at the front counter. Each $20 purchased will give you a bonus $5 worth of tokens. The only things that do not operate with tokens are the rides; tickets for these can be purchased at the front counter, excluding the roller coaster which is removed and will be replaced with the Gemstone Mining attraction. / This arcade opens with limited hours from Fridays-Sundays during the school year and Wednesdays-Sundays during school vacations and summer.

12531.info_text: Indoor trampoline park located in the Greenleaf at Delran shopping center. This location was formerly a Launch Trampoline Park from 2019 through 2020, but shuttered for over a year during the coronavirus pandemic and reopened in late 2021 as the second Funzilla location. Its original sister location can be found in [b][url=]Fairless Hills, PA[/url][/b]. / All games take game cards loaded with cash value.

12532.info_text: Indoor family fun center that includes a trampoline park, playground, go-kart track, arcade, and more. / The arcade uses a card system where $1=10 credits. It costs $2 for the card itself unless you get one of the packages. The Gold Package comes with a 30 credit card, and the Platinum, VIP, and All-Day Packages come with a 50 credit card. Most of the games are 10 credits, but there some 5 credit games as well. The games will be listed in dollars, not credits. They also now have timed session plays, for all non-redemption games; it's $10.99 for 30 mins and $19.99 for an hour. / More information on their website and Facebook page. / They have a sister location in Delran, NJ.

12533.info_text: Small, unmanned arcade located inside the Valley View Mall. Has a mixture of rhythm games, claw machines, pinball machines, racing games, shooters, and more. All games take reloadable game cards.

12535.info_text: Opened on January 26, 2022, by Justin Field and Funtastic Arcade founder, James Pepion, Galaxy Game Room expands on the Funtastic formula by adding game lounge elements in the back of the arcade. / Pricing: All arcade cabinets are coin-operated and are equipped with credit card swipers, and games are $1 per credit. There are also two gaming couches that can be rented for $12/hour, and includes the latest video game consoles, 4 controllers and a 72" screen, and a VR headset that can be rented for $6/20 min.

12536.info_text: About: / Affordable Family Fun*Variety of Arcade Games*Lots of Ticket Games for Prizes / Description: / Game room fun for the entire family featuring a wide variety of pinball machines, / video arcade games, kiddie rides & more------vintage to modern. / Earn free games with our / customer appreciation cards. / Stop by and find out how today!! / General Information: / Contact us at gogffc@ptd.net / ------------------- / THIS INFORMATION WAS PULLED DIRECTLY FROM THEIR FACEBOOK PAGE, I DID NOT WRITE THIS INFORMATION. / CREDITS TO THE OWNER OF GALAXY OF GAMES FAMILY FUN CENTER AT ZERN'S FARMER'S MARKET. / -370K / ------------------- / Additional Information: / The atmosphere is pretty much the same appearance as the entire framer's market interface: a little dirty. / The area itself has some posters and prizes along its walls. The entire floor is the street! Although, that does not affect grounding of any of the machines. The arcade has been running since September 1st, 2010.

12537.info_text: Multipurpose entertainment venue with an arcade, motion simulators, pool tables, 6 lanes of mini bowling and a restaurant. / [b]Transit:[/b] SamTrans 251 to Bridgepointe and Chess. / [b]History:[/b] Founded by Hossein Yavari, who immigrated to the United States in 2011 and opened a bounce house venues in Belmont and San Bruno. In 2016, he relocated to open a full fledged FEC the the current location / Opening Times as of 8/11/2024

12538.info_text: Shady as hell arcade located inside the equally shady, dying [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7341#summary]Dover Mall[/url][/b] in Dover, DE. / The arcade appears to be unmanned and unsupervised, and from the looks of things, unmaintained as well. There may have been carpet on the floor here once upon a time but now it's just a bare concrete floor. Many games are out of order or in really bad condition. Games appear to take quarters, but most of the games have their costs scribbled out or scribbled over and it's never entirely clear exactly how much any of these games are supposed to cost. Some games have an out-of-state phone number to contact if you win a prize; calling that number puts you into a voicemail that does not have any further details. Play at your own risk... or better yet, don't play at all and don't give this place or this mall your money. / There is a [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=9229#summary]sister location in Langhorne, PA[/url] at the Oxford Valley Mall near Sesame Place, with similar pricing and lack of care given to the machines.

12539.info_text: Located inside the Oxford Valley Mall in Langhorne, PA, just a stone's throw from the Sesame Place theme park. Arcade can be found on the second floor across from the food court. Arcade is unmanned and barely has any upkeep, much like its [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=3559#summary]sister location in Dover, DE[/url][/b]. / All games take quarters, and there is a change machine on site. Most games also have bill acceptors installed. / In addition to the games listed here, there are also a couple of miscellaneous games out in the mall's pathways such as Jurassic Park, Rilix Coaster, and a few claw machines.

12541.info_text: Game Galaxy's sole location. It contains hundreds of arcade games and pinball tables neatly organized. A few Laserdisc and vector games are present at the location but are only playable on Saturdays. The place also has consoles to play at the front of the store, including consoles for fighting games, Super Smash Bros. Melee, retro titles, and a PSVR setup. There are some Nintendo Switch Taiko games and two controllers, but you'll have to set those up yourself. / [b]IMPORTANT:[/b] Some sections of games may be turned off to save energy. If a game is off when you visit (and it does not have an "out of order" sign), ask the staff at the front desk to turn them on. Most pinball machines are off but can be turned on by flipping a switch under the right leg. / Some newer pinball tables require quarters to play in addition to entry; prices are noted on this list and on the machines. There is the $25 premium rate you can pay at entry to play these tables at no extra charge. / Canned drinks and snacks may be purchased from the front desk. Soft drink cans are $2, water bottles are $1, and 8.5oz Red Bulls are $4. Selection of drinks vary. / This listing is by no means complete or accurate...

12542.info_text: Free-play arcade that focuses on pinball and retro games. It's $15 for 1 hour, $20 for 2 hours, and $25 for all day. They also sell games, do repairs, buy/sell arcade machines, and offer console gaming. Since they're also a retail shop, their stock can move pretty quickly, so there's a good chance this listing may potentially be out of date.

machine_prices.drs: 6.40 Credits / 2 Songs LIGHT MODE / 12.80 Credits / 1 Song PREMIUM MODE

12543.info_text: Game Nest has a unique collection of Japanese arcades along with many American classics. There is also console play with the hourly rate. There are 6 couch stations with 55" inch TVs with XBox, Playstation, and Nintendo Switch. Please call the store for any questions regarding our arcade games. / - / $12 per hour / Credit play available

12544.info_text: Similar to Bowlero/Lucky Strike, Game On is an upscale bowling venue located inside the Mohegan Sun Casino & Resort in Connecticut, which also features a bar, restaurant, karaoke room, pool tables, and arcade. All arcade games take game cards which can be purchased from the kiosks throughout the arcade, or at the main desk where you would book a bowling lane. / Game On is found close to the entrance from the Winter Garage, just as you leave the elevator and go through the hallway to the main area. Take the escalator downstairs and there you are. / If you intend on using their pool tables, be sure to bring your own chalk, as there isn't a guarantee that there will be any available. / This location is open to all ages daily, but becomes a 21+ venue after 10 PM. There is a sister arcade on property called [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=2836#summary]Cyber Quest[/url][/b] that is all ages until at least midnight daily.

12545.info_text: Huge FEC from Poppy Bank, includes Laser Tag, Bowling alley, Sports Complex, Gym, OmniArena VR, 3D theater, Indoor playground. / [b]Music Games[/b]: DDR and PIU. / [b]Payment:[/b] Uses Embed-based cards. Credits are known as "chips", and are 25%-off weekdays until 6:00PM. [url=https://visitepicenter.com/about-us/attraction-pricing]Up-to-date prices are at their website[/url] / [b]Notes:[/b]: Opening times are for the 2024 summer season.

12548.info_text: Location is pending opening as of September 30, 2020

12549.info_text: Pay-to-Play arcade and free activity room located in the Industry City complex in Brooklyn. Arcade runs via a Credit system with each single credit costing $0.25. You get bonus credits with the more credits you reload. Each scanner has a price based on raw credit value. / $10 = 40 credits / $20 = 80+20 credits / $50 = 200+80 credits / $100 = 400+200 credits

12550.info_text: Local card shop hidden in what remains of the Searstown Mall. You can enter through the door on the outside of the mall, to the left of the entrance, or through the inside. / Despite being advertised as having an arcade, the Pump It Up GX cabinet is unmaintained, damaged, and considered a nuisance by the card shop regulars and staff. You will need to ask staff to turn the sound on. The community is currently undergoing restoration efforts to bring this cabinet back to life, and this page will hopefully be updated.

12551.info_text: We have moved to Moody Street in Waltham! We sell video games, host tournaments, and do birthday and private parties. Come visit us! / Public Transportation (from Boston/Cambridge): / Train: Wachusett/Fitchburg Line @ North Station/Porter Square (Fastest and easiest) / Bus: Bus 70 from Central Square in Cambridge or Bus 553 from Newton. Easy to transfer onto one of these bus routes if you are not located near an immediate stop. / For up to date information visit: https://mbta.com / Recently switched from tokens to a RFPay game card system. $50 gets you 600 credits, $2 for new card activations. Games range in price from 3 credits to 12 credits, so roughly about 25¢ to $1.00 per game. / All music games are now online! Game Underground has an active arcade community! Our game selection and maintenance changes frequently. For the most up to date information on a specific game please call or ask someone local.

12553.info_text: Japanese inspired arcade in the Kent area. / Arcade is pay-to-enter, all games are on free play except for prize and card games which require tokens. / (Tokens are available for purchase at entry, or can be earned by completing a challenge- see website) / Pricing: $25 for day pass, 10$ for entry 1 hour before close

12555.info_text: Two floor arcade & bar located inside Southington's Factory Square complex of shops and attractions. Open six days a week; 21+ only Tuesday through Saturday. Sundays are family days, where all ages are welcome but anyone under 21+ must be accompanied by an adult. / All games operate on their own custom tokens. Tokens can be purchased at the bars on either floor in the following configurations: / $5 - 20 tokens / $10 - 40 tokens / $20 - 80 tokens / $45 - 200 tokens / Games range between 1 to 4 tokens per play. Mixed drinks and draft beer are available on the ground floor, while the upstairs bar servers canned beer and cocktails only. While they do not have a kitchen on site, they offer small packages of snacks, and also have a partnership with their nearby neighbor The Lab @ Factory Square to provide direct-to-table delivery. / Rhythm games on site as of January 2026 include DDR SuperNova 2, multiple Guitar Hero Arcade machines, and a console setup with Rock Band 4 in the private room upstairs.

12556.info_text: Game store specializing in merchandise sales.

12557.info_text: Bar, grill, and retro arcade across 1.5 floors in the Merriweather District in Columbia, Maryland. One of three locations in the greater Baltimore area. / All games take tokens; there is a change machine on site that can change up to $10 bills, and the bar can break $20 bills if needed. / All ages until 8 PM (9 PM on Sunday, Tuesday, and Wednesday) as long as minors are accompanied by guardians of legal age. 21+ only after that point.

12558.info_text: Arcade currently located on the lower level next to Macy's and Gold's Gym. The arcade operates on tokens. You can currently redeem 3 tokens for $1, token machine is located in the rear of the arcade to the left of the DDR cabinet.

12559.info_text: Used game store on the second floor with a ddr extreme machine. / 4/27/2024 - The machine is out of order at the moment. / 3/15/2025 - At long last the cabinet has been repaired. I will update this with more information once I have a chance to visit.

12568.info_text: GameTime is the ultimate family entertainment destination with fun indoor amusements such as mini bowling, skee-ball, basketball, racing games, and more! Play over 100 interactive games on the Mega Arcade floor with friends and family. Visit on Thursday nights for unlimited games for the last 5 hours they are open for only $10! GameTime also offers a full-service dining experience and full liquor sports bar complete with indoor and outdoor seating. Try the Play with Your Food deal for only $21.99! Enjoy a delicious lunch or dinner and receive a 90 minute timed play card with your meal. While you're at it, watch any game on over 60 HDTVs throughout the restaurant! Happy hour is from 4pm-8pm on Monday-Friday. Get 50% off all drinks! GameTime is a great place to host your next celebration. Birthday Parties for all ages, Youth Groups, and Corporate Events are just a few of our specialties! For more information, contact the events department at Events.Kissimmee@gametimeplayers.com. Visit any day of the week for special deals, great food, and tons of fun for any age.

12584.info_text: Entry to the game room requires a buffet plate purchase. If you're merely curious, you can ask to peek around the game room (just say it's for a potential future visit). / Location uses game cards with a bar code that is swiped. If swiped correctly, the button will start flashing and show your card balance. Pressing the button inserts a credit into a game. / The non-redemption games have "Time Play Available" which is for use at parties only. An employee may be able to enable it if you ask, but it's not likely. / Any game problems can be reported to the person at the prize desk so he/she can notify the on-site tech of the problem. The game will most likely go out of service even if a tech is not available. / Editor's Note: Games listed as "Unknown" are untested but working, unless otherwise noted. / ----- / DDR is Supernova 2 but pads are in awful condition.

12628.info_text: Haze's Toys is a hybrid arcade and toy store with the Northgate Center being its first location. It's located in Section C, the northwest section of the indoor part mall. / Music Games: Two cabinets of each: / - maimai / - CHUNITHM VERSE / - DANCERUSH STARDOM / Music Games: One cabinet of each: / - DanceDanceRevolution A20 PLUS / - SOUND VOLTEX EXCEED GEAR / - WACCA Reverse / - O.N.G.E.K.I. / Pricing: / - Free Play for all consumer-grade cabinets (Arcade 1Up, MVSX). / - Full-sized arcade cabs take tokens (while some also take dollar bills). / - One token costs 50 cents at the machine or you can purchase with a credit card at the counter. / History: Haze's Toys is inspired by the owner's autistic child who struggled during the COVID-19 pandemic lockdowns.
