On September 3rd 2022, they opened their first store at the Northgate Mall in San Rafael.

12629.info_text: For $5 all the games are free except pinball and pool. There’s also a membership available for $12/month which would have to be the cheapest way to play on a DDR arcade for long periods of time i’m aware of. Unfortunately they close at 11 most weekdays. They have a Supernova machine, pinball, board games, a mortal combat dedi-cab, and a whole host of consoles and emulators at every couch. Their menu of game discs is also available on their website. All covered under that $5 charge.

12633.info_text: Located Inside the Pueblo Mall. $15 Entry Fee with unlimited visits for the day. Mostly American Arcade but has some J-Cabs too.

12636.info_text: An all ages arcade inspired by the games we came to love in the 70’s, 80’s and 90’s. Pinball. Arcade. Consoles. / $12 entry, or $40 for a group of four into the arcade gets you all day access inside, including DDR and pinballs. / Two DDR Machines! Supernova 2 and Extreme Pro Clarity, both pad sets are countersunk with new sensors! / Pop'N Music plays very well. / Sound Voltex and Jubeat are now online! (Eagle, 6/24/24) / Hours vary depending on the time of year, please check Facebook page for most frequent updates. / If you are coming from out of town and would like to play one of the other mixes available on the Extreme Pro machine, feel free to holler at me on Twitter @karl_bjj, or karlbjj on Discord. If it works with my schedule we'll make it happen.

12637.info_text: Since 2017 High Score Saloon has thrived in the heart of downtown Evansville. Recently relocated to our new larger space at 309 Main in Spring of 2023, High Score Saloon offers craft brews, cocktails, light food fare and the best arcade/pinball lineup in the region.

12638.info_text: High Scores Arcade owns about 160 games, but only has enough space to hold about 40, so they rotate games on a regular basis. Please contact the arcade to make sure the game you want to play is available. / [i]Pricing:[/i] Admission is $10.00 per person for an hour or $22.00 per person all-day, with all games set to free play. / [i]Transportation[/i] : AC Transit Routes 20, 21, 51A, 78, and O at Park Street and Santa Clara Avenue. There is a metered parking lot behind the arcade near Kaiser Permanente, with a walkway between it and the front entrance. / [i]History:[/i] High Scores Arcade is a privately owned "interactive spite arcade museum" opened in August 2010 by Shawn and Meg Livernoche. Along with games, they have plaques on the walls that give the history of Arcades, including the ban on stand-alone arcades in Alameda County. They once had a location in Hayward, CA, but they closed it down because of the COVID-19 pandemic and later opened [url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7406]another location in Monterey[/url]. They are another game preservation organization similar to the Pacific Pinball Museum nearby. They're known outside of the arcade community. fo...

12640.info_text: They have Fast and Furious Super Cars now 11/10 / In all seriousness, the game room/arcade here is pretty small, but the selection is fairly well rounded / Hours shown may not reflect the actual availability of the game room

12641.info_text: Retro shore arcade with a heavy emphasis on games that are from at least a decade ago or older. Seasonal business, so double check their hours before visiting. / [s]All games take quarters.[/s] As of the 2025 season, they have switched to a game card system.

12642.info_text: $12 for free play all day through operating hours. Experience the nostalgia of your favorite arcade games and more at Hometown Arcade. Located in Hull, Massachusetts, next to the historic Paragon Park Carousel, we offer a wide selection of over 20 classic arcade games, Skee-ball, bubble hockey, air hockey, and modern gaming consoles (PS5 and Nintendo Switch) for the ultimate gaming experience. Follow us today for updates and get ready to relive the glory days of arcade gaming! In addition, we also sell Pinball machines and Arcade cabinets via our online store.

12643.info_text: Free play arcade located in Bloomfield with a heavy emphasis on retro game classics. $20 all day admission, no quarters necessary. Over 30 classic games from the 70's through 90's, as well as a mix of modern pinball machines along one wall. In addition to the arcade games, there is also a side room with couches and consoles hooked up to TVs. / Soft opening was on Saturday, October 26th, 2024. Official grand opening was on Friday, November 1st, 2024. As of March 1st, 2025 they have an on-site bar open to the public daily after 4 PM, and no outside drinks will be permitted. All ages are still allowed, but anyone underage should be accompanied by someone 21+. / They have two sister locations in the state of Massachussetts; the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7476#summary]original location in Norwood[/url][/b], and their [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=9551#summary]newest location in Northampton[/url][/b].

12644.info_text: One of two arcades inside the historic Great America amusement park. This is the smaller arcade at the front of the park. Park hours vary by season; check before visiting.

12645.info_text: Retro-inspired freeplay arcade located on the lower level of the Thornes Marketplace in downtown Northampton, Massachussetts. / Entry is $10 for one hour, or $20 for all-day access. The majority of the games in the arcade are set to freeplay; the only exceptions are the pinball machines that are located to the left of the front desk, and the claw machine near the back of the arcade, which is $3.00 per play and set to play until you win. If you are only playing the pinball machines, you do not need to pay for entry. The pinball machines take tokens (2/$1.00) dispensed by the nearby change machine. / Free play entry also gives you access to a variety of consoles hooked up to 7 different flatscreens and 3 classic CRTs, everything from the Atari 2600 to Nintendo Switch 2. / This arcade has sister locations that can be found in [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=9419#summary]Bloomfield, New Jersey[/url][/b] and [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7476#summary]Norwood, Massachusetts[/url][/b].

12647.info_text: Ice cream parlor and a retro arcade. Arcade games range from 25¢ to $1.00. They also serve boba and fruit flavored soda.

12649.info_text: Arcade with mostly older school arcade games, no ticket games. Pay 1 fee, and it's unlimited play. $15 door fee. / Rhythm games are maintained by @Shilofax on the Alabama Music Gamers Discord. / https://discord.gg/Tw6hqcw / Notes: Uses Eagle.ac server for Bemani games.

12650.info_text: Small clawcade located on the ground floor of the Garden State Plaza mall. All games take tokens. Current pricing is as follows: / $10 - 10 tokens (guaranteed 1 small prize if you don't win) / $20 - 22 tokens (guaranteed 1 big prize or 2 small prizes if you don't win) / $35 - 40 tokens (guaranteed any 3 prizes if you don't win) / $50 - 58 tokens / $100 - 118 tokens / In addition to the claw machines, there is also a Multicade 60-in-1 arcade cabinet that takes tokens, as well as a dance pad hooked up to a PC running Stepmania for free play. / Has sister locations in Manhattan and Flushing.

12651.info_text: Local pizzeria with a small arcade. Uses a card system.

12652.info_text: Independent family entertainment center that includes a 12-lane bowling alley, 6 batting cages, a restaurant, a laser maze, and a large arcade with a big variety of games including pinball, redemption, sports, racing, VR, and more. / All games take play cards; machines do not accept cash.

12653.info_text: The name and contact number of this location have been changed due to the presence of games outside of Cinemark. / As of December 19, 2018, there is an arcade called "Fun City" with Pump It Up NX (despite the marquee). / As of June 21, 2019, Pump It Up NX and Guitar Hero are still there. The right pad for the former might not be the best for higher level songs as the responsiveness seemed questionable, and stepping on it quickly produced loud steps. A fan was on for the left side. There was also a fan on the right, but it was not on that day. / The movie theater is great. It has a great athmosphere too. Probably the best movie theater in the area. / Regardless of the hours, the mtheater may stay later because of showtimes.

12654.info_text: Multipurpose entertainment venue with a small arcade, karaoke, and VR/video game console rentals.

12655.info_text: Barcade, has Supernova 2 (as of 6/7/22) and other various arcade games

12656.info_text: A hybrid between a Gaming Lounge and Arcade (a competitor to BHOP E-Sports Hawthorn). / Their Arcade is meh, there's a couple good games like SMX (we'll touch on that later), Mario Kart Arcade DX, and Time Crisis 5. The rest are redemption games and or average rail-shooters. / Ignite offers a large library of games on PC and Consoles (which are all listed on their website), alongside two Rock Band 4 Studios (which are way too damn expensive for what they're worth, being $25/$45 an hour on the weekdays/weekends). / The SMX cab is also pretty expensive. You can easily burn through $75 reload in a few hours as it is 1 song/swipe

12657.info_text: The original Japanese rhythm game and arcade center in Pittsburgh. / An official partner/sponsor of GamesDoneQuick (GDQ)! / Located a little over 1 mile from Carnegie Mellon University (CMU) and the University of Pittsburgh (Pitt)! / Join the Ikigai Arcade Discord! / https://discord.gg/EHPstenxzn / Official maimai DX (International) IS HERE!! / Pittsburgh's first official e-Amusement (Konami) arcade! / We currently have DDR, Sound Voltex, Pop'n Music and beatmania IIDX! / Jubeat coming in ~Jan (2027) / Ikigai Arcade prides it self on providing an unmatched experience that makes you feel like you just walked off the streets of Akihabara! You wont find better maintained games anywhere else! / Paid street parking on Baum Blvd. Free street parking on Amber Street and some on Stratford Ave / All street parking is free on holidays, Sunday and any day after 6pm! / Taking the Bus? The 71A / 71C stop on Negley Ave + Baum is a 2 min walk to our front door! / We are located on the 3rd floor, accessible via stairs only. / NO OUTSIDE FOOD ALLOWED. NO OPEN DRINKS/CANS ON THE ARCADE FLOOR. / Ikigai Arcade does however allow and sell drinks and small snacks. / All machines use the RF-Pay card p...

12659.info_text: Found in the basement of the Illini Union building, next to the food court. Much of the maintenance of the machines is managed by DDRIllini, UIUC's rhythm game club, with the majority of the focus on the ITG2 cabinet. The ITG2 cabinet is hacked with a large amount of extra content and custom themes and at this point is the only frequently-maintained public dedi in the state. / NOTE: Summer hours during the weekend are different (opens at 5 PM on Sundays)

12660.info_text: Fremont's latest arcade, runs on a card system like most arcades nowadays / Food and Beverages (inc. alcohol) can be bought in the back by the bar / Location becomes 21+ only after 10PM / 1$ = 4 Credits / Game prices vary from 6 - 12 credits, most are 10 credits / Attractions like the hanging bar game up front and VR experiences are 48 credits

12661.info_text: "Games, prizes and experiences you can only find at In The Game. Compete or play for fun. From axe throwing to high-tech games – come in and be the winner you know you are! / Serving up delicious burgers, pizza and appetizers perfect for a quick bite or for lunch or dinner. With a full service bar as well your favorite cocktail and beer and wine too!"

12662.info_text: In the game is the arcade section of the South 40 restaurant it includes six Lanes of mini bowling all the arcade games every other arcade has as well as StepManiaX and a VR theater.

12664.info_text: Great place to take your kids! Game room is LOUD!!!!! Fun cabinets but they removed "panic park" (namco) / they removed Max Flight (Max Flight corp) so its pretty sad for me, but i still like it! Laser tag has rules not to run, crawl, or roll / and go carts must be 14 to ride the fast cars, or 48 inches to ride alone on the slow cars. I had a blast there! Great redemption fruit ninja game! I could go on forever, but I want you to go try it out!

12665.info_text: Need to buy a buffet or $10 game card to enter. I prefer the $10 game card route.

12667.info_text: Seasonally open pop-up skating rink on the Delaware River waterfront in Philly. Has two operating seasons; the Winterfest is open from the end of November to the beginning of March, while the Summerfest is open between May and September. Check the website for the most up to date hours, but they are typically open 7 days a week during their operational seasons. / There are a number of arcade games that can be found inside the skate rental building on site, including rhythm games, pinball, claw machines, and more. All games take reloadable game cards at a rate of 25¢ per one credit (no bonus for higher loads). All games are provided and maintained by Apple Vending.

12668.info_text: Not sure what they have here. They do have a DDR machine here though: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=df2oz6bCGWE / Update 6/1/2013: This video shows an EXTREME, it's old though: http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=seEBh_niLss

12669.info_text: Indy Karting is the Lowcountry's premier destination for high-speed excitement and family-friendly fun. Located in the heart of Bluffton, South Carolina, we are committed to fostering a welcoming environment that encourages community and camaraderie. It has indoor go karts, arcade, mini bowling, and axe throwing.

machine_prices.sdvx: 10 credits ($1.00) / 3 songs Light Start / 20 credits ($2.00) / 3+ songs Standard Start / 20 credits ($2.00) / 3+ songs BLASTER GATE / 10 credits ($1.00) / Skill Analyzer

12673.info_text: Bowling alley with a large redemption style arcade, as well as a bar & grill, laser tag, and party room. All games take reloadable game cards.

12674.info_text: In The Groove 2 Dedicab / Condition: Excellent

12675.info_text: Machine is located in the Minor's Arcade Camp, next to the pool. / P1 right and P2 up are sticking. / No songs unlocked as of 10/20/2010.

12676.info_text: Private home arcade, but open based on appointment. Please email Jacqueline at jacqueline@ordrstudio.com to set up. / Games: / - StepmaniaX / - ItG/DDR both on StepmaniaX pad / - Official Phoenix Pump on converted StepmaniaX pad

12677.info_text: Welcome to JAEGERS Subsurface Paintball, the world's first and only underground paintball arena catering to all skill levels of the game. Indoor Paintball Fields nestled in the hillside of one of Kansas City's oldest limestone mines, JAEGERS has 7 underground recreation fields and a 2-man speedball field set up year round.

12678.info_text: Laser Tag, Arcade, Bowling and Whatnot.

12679.info_text: A small unmanned space towards the back of the second floor. Games require tokens, and can be purchased from a change machine either by using cash, credit, or tap-to-pay. Each token costs $1. / As of October 19th, 2023, this location was the home to a test of the Naruto Arcade Battle card battling arcade game. The location test was scheduled to run through November 12th. It is no longer there, and has since been renamed Naruto Emblem Battle for wider release.

12680.info_text: ----==== Jeremy's Downtown Arcade: ====---- / - All Ages $5 Admission, Unlimited Play All Day. / - $20 Unlimited Play All Month / - Rhythm game nights on the last Thursday of each month. Air hockey tournaments every Sunday night. / - IC cards available for purchase with attendant. / Entrances on 12th Avenue S across from the library and the Wall Street alley. / Press the doorbell on the desk behind either door to call the attendant and get a wristband or set up a membership. Cash, credit/debit cards, and mobile payments are accepted. / This arcade contains many uncommon and rare games (especially rhythm games) from a variety of genres and eras, with a focus on Japanese imports, rhythm games, pinball, and a variety of other games from the 80s up to the early 2010s. Games have historically not been frequently maintained, but this has been changing as of late. Some members of the community assist with maintenance for some rhythm games. / ITG notes: Owned and maintained by a community member and hosted at Jeremy's, running ITGMania with Simply Spud (a Simply Love fork), USB profiles/custom songs enabled (plug a FAT32-formatted flash drive into the ports on the control panel to save...

12681.info_text: Arcade on the OCNJ boardwalk located directly next to the Surf Mall and a block away from Playland's Castaway Cove. Housed in a distinctively shaped building that formerly held a carousel, this place is filled with classic Jersey shore staples such as Skeeball, claw machines, air hockey, and pinball. Until early 2024, this spot was home to a DDR X cabinet, but as of April 2024 it has since been removed and its whereabouts are unknown. / All games accept either cash or game cards. It is highly recommended to purchase game cards as you will typically get bonus credits on your card and at some points throughout the year may effectively double your value. / Be sure to double check the website for the most up-to-date hours before visiting, they can change them on short notice. Hours listed below are current as of April 2024.

12682.info_text: Joe's Playland is the seasonal arcade located at Broadway at Salisbury MA. Consists of two arcades. 10 Broadway is open year round, 15 Broadway is open Late May to Mid October.

12685.info_text: This is a good pizza parlor if you want to eat while watching different TV programs (depending on the room). I don't know if there is an entrance fee at the moment. / DanceDanceRevolution EXTREME does not have memory card access, but 3 points from the point card are required.

12686.info_text: You are required to purchase a buffet just to enter (Adults: $9.49), and game cards cost 25 cents. Also note that food and drink isn't allowed into the game area. Though you can go back for new plates and glasses as often as you'd like. The people here are very friendly too.

12687.info_text: A buffet/arcade & amusement center, located inside the Buena Park Downtown Mall. Home of several rides/attractions like bumpers cars, a twister ride, and more! Games use a card system that scan the barcodes of cards, compared to usual card systems that have you swipe your card. Cards are available for purchase in the kiosks, located at the front desk when you enter.

12688.info_text: John’s Incredible Pizza is a buffet/arcade located in a former Kmart in Carson, California. It features many games and attractions, including a spinning roller coaster inside. Games and attractions use a card system that is located in a kiosk.

12689.info_text: I have a DDR Extreme Machine in perfect working condition. Modded Pads, and running DDR X3 and ITG. Text me if you ever want to play. I love meeting new people, and play nearly every day.

12690.info_text: Barcade on second floor, focusing on classic favorites, pinball, racing, and rhythm games. / $25 Unlimited Play / Since Joysticks is so new, info about rhythm games here is still somewhat slim. Specific close up pictures of available games and server information would be great!

12691.info_text: Hangout place with food/bar and arcade. Karaoke booth on 2nd floor. / Games that are not in the games list include giant jenga, beanbag toss, shuffleboard, darts, and a Pandora Box GX machine, all on the 2nd floor, and a bunch of pinball machines and two pool tables by the front entrance on the first floor. / Note: The prices and condition for the games aren't listed because I didn't want to test all of the games, but all games are between $0.25 and $1.00 to play (with some games having special modes for $2.00) and they were all on and appeared to be working (unless noted otherwise) when I checked them.

12693.info_text: Arcade Is On The Right After You Show Your Ticket. I don't know if you need to buy a ticket to get in, if anyone can clarify that, please do.

machine_prices.ddr: 9 tokens for normal member / 8 tokens for gold/VIP member / Premium Play is no additional cost (1 credit both normal play and premium play) / Comes to around $2 USD per game
machine_prices.iidx: 9 credits / 1 play (with regular card. Approx. US$2.25) / 8 credits / 1 play (with VIP card. Approx. US$2.00) / 2 plays / PREMIUM FREE (10 minutes)
machine_prices.maimai_dx: 9 credits / 1 play (with regular card. Approx. US$2.25) / 8 credits / 1 play (with VIP card. Approx. US$2.00)
machine_prices.sdvx: 13 credits / 1 play (normal card) / 12 credits / 1 play (VIP card) / 4 swipes / Premium Time

12695.info_text: It's 1 of 3* arcades within the mall. The other one is Lucky Strike Social on the 2nd floor, and Dave n Busters also on the ground floor. Games are pretty decent. Not too crowded. Tourist prices so costs are pretty expensive.

12696.info_text: As soon as you walk in, it's to the right, in the "Speed Zone" room. Pads are not typical DDR X quality, you can actually AA and possibly AAA your songs. Felt the pads gave a few slight errors, otherwise it's one of the better X machines in the US. / update 6/7/2019 the DDR X machine is in the back beside the rock climbing wall. The right side pad works pretty well but the left side is pretty much unplayable / Update 11/11/2019, DDR X was not working, it was down since the Hurricane Dorian aftermath in September, there was a LCD problem, and the employees there were finding a LCD replacement. / Update 11/23/2019, DDR X is working again!!!!! / Update 7/12/2020, the arcade was currently temporary closed, along with all other arcades in North Carolina to prevent spreading of COVID-19. Phase 3 may include the reopening of the arcades (including JR's arcade zone), and it is expected to happen on July 17, 2020. / 2021 Update: Jungle Rapids has since reopened, with safety measures; along with the rest of the arcades in North Carolina. / July 2022: The note below about being able to AA/AAA songs must be 10+ years old. I had false optimism based on it that maybe the machine was modified...

12698.info_text: Formerly known as "Grand Prix New York", this location was converted to part of the K1 Speed chain mid-2024. It features an indoor go-kart track, a bowling alley, a bar and restaurant, a ninja course (on weekends only), and over a hundred arcade games. / All games take reloadable game cards running on the Amusement Connect system. Pricing as of October 2025 is as follows; / $10: 200 tokens (5¢/token) / $10 + $2 boost: 250 tokens (4.8¢/token) / $20: 400 tokens (5¢/token) / $20 + $4 boost: 500 tokens (4.8¢/token) / $40: 800 tokens (5¢/token) / $40 + $5 boost: 1025 tokens (4.39¢/token) / $60: 1350 tokens (4.4¢/token) / $60 + $5 boost: 1700 tokens (3.82¢/token) / $100: 2250 tokens (4.4¢/token) / $100 + $5 boost: 3000 tokens (3.5¢/token) / The building itself isn't easy to find. By driving on North Bedford Road, you would have to look for a road sticking out to the west, with a board listing all of the places the road leads to, going downhill. The sign isn't in an entirely visible position, and the text on the sign is small, so it may be very easy to miss. If going north on N. Bedford Road, the entrance is on the first left after the Nissan car dealership.

12699.info_text: New Family Entertainment Center opened in Jul. 17, 2021. Featuring Inflatable Course, Ninja Course, Laser Tag, & Arcade w/Redemption. Be sure you sign your waiver to get in.

machine_prices.popn: $1 a play for 3 songs on normal mode or battle.

12700.info_text: Keg & Coin is Jacksonville’s first arcade bar bringing the city a unique nostalgic experience. Play the best arcade games from the 80s and 90s while trying craft beer on one of our 15 rotating taps or from the cooler. Pick something up from our package store where you can find the best craft beer around. One-of-a-kind retro merchandise is available, from toys to t-shirts. There is something for everybody at Keg & Coin.

12701.info_text: One of two primary arcades located within the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=10457#summary]Kennywood[/url][/b] amusement park in West Mifflin, PA. Admission is required to enter the park. / More games can be found throughout the park as well as at the other primary arcade, the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=10459#summary]Kennywood Games Pavilion[/url][/b] located across from the Pittsburg Plunge. / All games in both arcades use a reloadable game card for credits and e-tickets. / Park is open seasonally; check the website for the most up-to-date schedule.

12702.info_text: Yes, they actually have a Pump it Up machine at the Kentucky Science Center. It's on the 3rd floor in an exhibit about health, and it's set to free play. Entrance fee is $13 for 13+, $11 for 2-12, and $5 for anyone after 5PM.

machine_prices.ddr: $2 / 3 songs NORMAL PLAY / $2 / 3 songs PREMIUM PLAY / $2 / 3 songs GALAXY PLAY
machine_prices.popn: $2 / 3 songs NORMAL MODE / $2 / 5-6 songs EXTRA MODE / $2 / 10 minutes TIME PLAY MODE / $3 / 16 minutes TIME PLAY MODE

12706.info_text: Branch location of the Kiddleton claw machine arcade chain. All machines use proprietary coins for payment. / Note that despite listed regular hours, the store opens and closes whenever it feels like so it is possible you may show up during regular hours only to find it closed.

12707.info_text: One of three in San Francisco's Japantown, located next to Marufuku Ramen and primarily focused on claw games. Uses proprietary coin system for credits.

12711.info_text: Kidstar Park is located near the Sun Flea Market. Take U.S. 41 to Veterans Blvd (east) and you'll see a light with Paulson Dr. and Murdock Circle. Paulson Dr. is where you go. Go next left to the parking lot. Game room is located near the go-kart area, also near laser tag, and the main section in the restaurant with more machines in a side room. / Token Pricing: / $10 - 100 Tokens | Best Value / Worse rates at lower tiers. / Phone Number: (941) 255-7827

12712.info_text: Military Camp, check the website for how to get in. / ——————————————————————————— / As of Summer 2018, this is closed indefinitely due to volcano eruptions. / As for the current game list, the list was never updated 7 years ago (when it was created). As a result, the status is unknown. / According to their hours - it seems they are ipen every day from 6:30AM - 4PM

12714.info_text: All-day Freeplay retro arcade + classic consoles

12715.info_text: STEPMANISAX MACHINE HAS BEEN OUT OF ORDER SINCE OCTOBER. STAFF HAS EXPRESSED NO INTENT IN FIXING. :( / Open for Summer B, note updated hours. / Restaurant in the UCF Student Union that is open to both students and non-students. Parking is free on the 3rd and 4th floor of Garage F. The restaurant has typical bar/pub food such as pretzels, pizza, tenders, & more. / Games are 100% FREE TO PLAY, regardless of if you are a customer, but please consider purchasing food or drink to support them and keep them open.

12716.info_text: Newly opened "Eatertainment" venue in the Shadow Creek area of Pearland, TX. / Uses a card-based credits system, with pricing starting at $5 for 40 credits.

12717.info_text: [B]This is a Bowling and Family Fun Center facility with the following rules in place[/b] / This location uses games cards - Socoa Type (Local Network) / New game cards have a $1.00 surcharge / No Outside Food or Drinks - Snack Bar available / Game Card System accepts Cash and Credit Card / [b]Game Card Rates[/b] / $1.00 = 3 Spurs / $5.00 = 16 Spurs / $10.00 = 32 Spurs / $20.00 = 92 Spurs / *Prices on games below assume the base rate of a purchase. / [color=red][b]WARNING! - DDR is bootleg![/b][/color]

12718.info_text: One of three arcades located inside the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=3008#summary]Busch Gardens Williamsburg[/url][/b] amusement park. This one is located in the Germany section, near the Oktoberfest carnival games and Festhaus dining hall. All games take game cards with credits. / The park is open seasonally, and hours are subject to change; please visit the website before making the trip.

12720.info_text: Since 1958, Lake Shore Athletic Club has provided the Vancouver area with a family-oriented fitness and recreation facility that is second to none. We make sure our members have a wide selection of activities to choose from, including swimming pools, a conditioning room, and personal training. Since we want the whole family to participate, we offer plenty of social events and programs that are open to all ages. As we look toward the next 60 years, we’ll continue providing our community with instruction for all their athletic pursuits, outstanding equipment, and a supportive environment.

12721.info_text: Located just off the shores of Lake Wylie on the border of North and South Carolina, Lake Wylie Pins N' Wins (formerly Lake Wylie Bowl N' Bounce), is a locally-owned and operated family entertainment center featuring bowling, laser tag, redemption arcade, a youth play area, sports viewing, food and bar service. With a mission to be the preeminent entertainment destination in the Lake Wylie area, they have something for all ages and are available for open and league bowling, birthday parties, private parties, church events, corporate gatherings and more.

12722.info_text: Lakewood Camping Resort is a campground located in Myrtle Beach, SC. The campground has an arcade with PIU NX as well as a collection of other games. / The entrance to the resort is located off of S. Kings Highway on Possum Trot Street, but the arcade is located on the corner of Main Street and Ocean Boulevard, which is inside the campground. I would suggest looking at the geolocation for the arcade itself. Since this is a resort, you do have to have accomodations to even get to the arcade. If you end up staying here or have friends who have invited you here, feel free to visit.

12723.info_text: PLEASE NOTE: This is a bar; nobody under the age of 21 is allowed in the arcade area after 9 PM.

12724.info_text: Arcade (Redemption games + SMX) / Laser Tag $5 (12min game) / Bowling alley $5.50/hr + $4 shoes / Rock wall $7 (15min of climbing) / Timber Town $7 all day (Kids Play Place) / Restaurant and Bar / The Tack Room (21+ only) / Still Closed: / High Ropes Course / Prices listed and updated more frequently on the website at https://langersfun.com/

12725.info_text: a nice arcade with go karts and 2 rides outside.

machine_prices.iidx: 1 Credit / Step up, Standard, Dan, and Free / Standard/Premium Start: 200/199p / Premium Time | 10m - 338p | 20m - 584p | 30m - 830p

12726.info_text: Welcome to Laser Assault, your home for entertainment and competition! We are excited to offer laser tag with top competitive equipment and a fun arena designed by people who actually play the arena with strategy and gameplay in mind. We use blacklights and bright neon paints, all set with great music as the perfect backdrop giving you a unique experience not found anywhere else. We proudly serve the Provo and Orem area. When it comes to laser tag, we wanted something a little more action packed than brightly lit up vests and superhero names on our chests. That’s why we opened our doors and brought back a staple that had been in the Utah County area for decades-- Truly Competitive Laser Tag / Representing the Arcade: https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/user?userid=24823 / For Feathers, dm round1usa on Discord.

12727.info_text: Queens location of a small family entertainment center chain. Located in the Shops at Atlas Park shopping complex. Take the escalator down in the main building to the basement and the entrance is to your left. All games operate on game cards. / Current pricing is: / $20 - 80 credits (25¢ per credit) / $25 - 110 credits (22.7¢ per credit) / $35 - 164 credits (21.3¢ per credit) / $50 - 240 credits (20.8¢ per credit) / $100 - 500 credits (20¢ per credit) / They also offer an unlimited time play option for $19.95 per hour, but it does not work on games that redeem tickets or the photobooths. / Machines are half price on Wednesdays when school is not on break.

machine_prices.ddr: 10 credits for one game. / 3 songs + Extra Stage + Encore Extra Stage.

12729.info_text: State-of-the-art family entertainment center. Offers over 60+ Arcade Games, Classics Arcade, Tactical Laser Tag, Archery Tag, Bazooka Ball and Virtual Reality Gaming to include Hyperdeck and Hologate. When you visit Laser Ops, you have the opportunity to play a variety of cutting-edge games all under one roof, in a premium, air-conditioned facility. Also has an onsite Bar and Grille that serves Full Bar Fare. Closed on Thanksgiving, and Christmas Day.

machine_prices.ddr: US$0.50 for 3 songs / US$0.50 to continue

12730.info_text: Explore three levels and thousands of square feet of excitement! Special lighting effects combine with heart-pounding music to propel you into another world. Discover new secrets around every turn as you track your opponents. Seek out GEMs (Game Enhancement Modules) for extra points and special powers. / Laser Web features the world's most advanced laser tag equipment, DarkLight. Challenge yourself in solo, team missions, and advanced games. Radio links provide instantaneous feedback and prompting. You've never played laser tag like this before! / Between laser tag missions, check out our arcade, featuring both new and classic games! / Laser Web welcomes all group events and parties, including corporate, church, athletic, and birthdays! Flexible arrangements and multiple party packages are available to meet your needs. Our friendly staff will exceed your expectations to assure your satisfaction!

12731.info_text: Medium-sized independent arcade and laser tag arena located between Hershey and Lancaster, just off of Route 283. / If you are traveling in the area, stop at a rest stop along the Interstate and look in the brochure racks for a flyer for this arcade. The flyers have a special offer that is redeemable for a complimentary three-hour game card for a small selection of unlimited free play games, which as of September 2023 includes air hockey, Dirty Drivin', Sink It, Skeeball, StepManiaX, and console play on their Xboxes. This complimentary card does have some caveats; you can only swipe it a maximum of two times in a row on the same game, and any of the redemption games will not issue tickets. You can also purchase time play packages from the counter that will give you access to all games and attractions, but again, the redemption games will not issue tickets (or, if they drop prizes, you will not be able to play at all). / Otherwise, if you would prefer to pay per game and earn tickets, you can purchase a separate game card. Value is stored in dollars, and you get some bonus value added to your card for adding certain amounts of money to your card: / $25 - $5 bonus, $30 total / $50...

12732.info_text: Laser tag arena with small arcade.

12735.info_text: Bowling alley with a pub and medium-sized arcade on premises. All arcade games take their own custom Intercard game cards, roughly at a rate of 25¢ per credit (slightly less if you buy a card with higher value, but honestly why would you want to).

12738.info_text: 11/12/15: DDR is gone / ------------------------------ / A fairly sized arcade with laser tag. The machine is in [s]bad condition. During a recent June 2025 visit, many games were unplugged and out of order, as they appeared to be in the process of reorganizing the layout. However, the owner Lindsey was happy to try and get some of the OOO games playable for us by request. If there are any issues with the games, please notify one of the members of the staff, as they will do their best to get things up and running for you, and if not possible, refund your tokens.

12976.info_text: Independent family entertainment center located in downtown Passaic, NJ. There is a paid parking lot directly to the left of the building; the paystation does not read cards, so either bring quarters or use the ParkMobile app. / The front room in Rack N Roll is mostly stuff geared towards younger children, including inflatable bounce houses, a small kiddie carousel, and the prize redemption counter. The majority of the arcade games are located in the back room, along with several pool tables. / They have a snack bar up front serving up hot dogs, burgers, chickie tendies, and pizza at very reasonable prices. You can also purchase an "Eat & Play" special which includes 1 large cheese pizza, 1 pitcher of soda with a free refill, and a game card with 15,000 points on it for only $20. / All games in this location take game cards, and their credits are stored in "RNR Points". These points are roughly equivalent to about $1 per 1,000 points, but you get some extra bonus points on your card every time you purchase a new card or reload so the exchange rate isn't quite exact. You also can get bonus points for loading larger amounts, causing the value per 1,000 points to be more favorable....

12977.info_text: $10 all you can play / Currently has the following Rhythm Games: / Jubeat Festo ( online ) / PIU - SDv2 - PRIME 2015 / 18+ after 9 p.m / Great Craft beer selection.

12980.info_text: This place has a rollerskating rink, laser tag, and apparently a minigolf course, also. There's a small arcade area, and a DDR Supernova machine right by the front door.

12981.info_text: Craft brewery and pub in DUMBO with a sizable game room. All games take tokens, which must be purchased from the bar at a rate of $1 per token. The location is all ages until 6 PM on weekdays, and until 2 PM on Saturdays, after which it is limited to those 18 and older. The game room does not open until 4 PM on weekdays, however. / All of the classic arcade games have had their original CRT monitors replaced with LCDs.

12983.info_text: Video Game/Anime/Music retailer with some arcade games and even a MGS3 Pachislot where any money from that goes to a local pet shelter.

12984.info_text: Hi guys this is the owner I will have all the games listed and keep this updated we are Quite small, with no staff, great machines. About half the arcade is prize games. We have recently started to add more machines expanding our space. Thank you to anyone who stops by and good luck. Our prizes are all high quality product unlike other arcades. We have the games on the list plus these. / 2 linked road burners / 60 in 1 multicade / Ghost squad evolution / House of the dead one / Rush n attack / Battle sharks / 3 major prize keymasters / 16 prize redemption games / 2 $1 capsule machines

12985.info_text: Combination arcade/venue/restaurant and lounge, all ages welcome. / $10 entry for free play arcade, pinball, and console game setups (suggested 4 hour max). / As this is also a venue, check their website/socials in advance to see if there is a concert happening when you visit, as entry pricing may change. I would strongly recommend bringing headphones/earbuds with strong noise isolation/cancellation as well if you plan to play rhythm games on these nights (this is generally not needed otherwise). / Realms has a good selection of well-maintained modern pinball machines, a few JP import arcade games (rhythm included), and a few other uncommon 80s-90s arcade games.

12986.info_text: A small, bar-focused arcade with a few older machines. A few staples like pac-man and frogger, and a few fighting games sprinkled around.

12987.info_text: Cozy, medium, arcade/bar. Contains mostly retro cabinets and pinball machines, as well as a few home consoles and more modern cabinets. / Tournaments, trivia nights, happy hours, drag shows, bingo nights, and other special events are held frequently. / Bar is 18+ only, some events are also 18+ / 21+ only. The entire arcade is 18+ only after 6 PM. / Anyone under 18 must be accompanied by an adult at all times, no more than 2 children per adult. / Anyone between 18 and 20 is required to make a minimum token purchase. Sunday - Thursday, the minimum purchase is $5. Friday - Saturday, the minimum purchase is $10. / New arcade machines are added infrequently, however, the current selection is diverse and kept up well. / Tokens are 4 for $1.

12988.info_text: It's a party event space mostly focused around the bar and games like cornhole and ping pong. / There is a door cover charge of $10. / If you're just there to play pinball or dance games, you can request a wristband upon paying the door fee once. / The wristband lets you in to play pinball or dance games without paying the door fee in the future. / The operator has requested that I also say that if the person at the desk doesn't know what you're talking about when you ask for the wristband, to ask for the manager, who should know about it.

12989.info_text: Rec Room LKLD is an arcade bar in downtown Lakeland FL / Full bar with weekly cocktails and drink specials. / 21+ AFTER 9PM / Arcade games take 1-4 tokens, some arcade machines are on free play. There are also swipe cards with a kiosk ($1 surcharge for new cards) / There is a Nintendo Switch and a Playstation 4 located at the bar available for patrons to play. / There are also booths available for rent by the hour that are equipped with Nintendo Switches and Playstation 4s. / Other things available include a Shuffleboard table and a Ping Pong table.

12990.info_text: Retro barcade in Louisville. All ages admitted, but children under 16 must be accompanied by a parent or a guardian at all times. No one under 21 (w/valid I.D.) are allowed after 10PM. / This place has a lot of classic arcade games and pinball tables. While they're intended to receive tokens, standard quarters will also work.

12992.info_text: Red Note is the ultimate rhythm gaming center located in Las Vegas, NV! You can get 2 hours of play for only $13!

12994.info_text: This location no longer has a DDR machine.

12996.info_text: The arcade is inside the theater on the left side. There's an usher who may check for tickets before allowing you to enter the theater.

12999.info_text: A vintage and retro arcade, specializing in older upright cabinets and pinball machines. / $16 for 1 hour, $20 for 2 hours and $22 for All Day Free Play. / Monthly memberships and group discounts available. / Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/retrocityarcadeevans/

13000.info_text: Over 120 Arcade Machines, 15 Console Gaming Stations and a Guitar Hero Station. / Full game list on their website. / Pay Once at the Door and Play all Day! / No Quarters, No Tokens, No Hassle! / All Day Passes only $8/Person / Wednesdays:$5/Person / Tuesdays+Thursdays: B1G1 Free Admission

13001.info_text: GAME LIST UPDATED AS OF 4/28/22 / (For a more up-to-date game list, visit their website!) / NOW OPEN ON WEDNESDAYS! / Retro-styled pinball and arcade place! / All games are on free play! Just pay the following for Admission: / Standard - $10 per hour (or $8 Military Discount) / Kids under 10 - $8 per hour / ALL DAY PASS - $25 / Family 4-Pack - $30 Per hour (Only valid on Saturdays and Sundays. Cannot be used with any other discount or offer.) / Wednesday-Friday Discount - $15 ALL DAY PASS

13002.info_text: Located next to (and must enter through) the Classic Game Junkie store. Soft-opening on December 9th, 2022. Official grand opening on February 4th, 2023. $15 gets you a wristband which allows you to play games all day on free play and come in and out as you please. Also offers a pack of 5 wristband coupons for the price of 4 ($60 plus tax). These can be used across one or multiple visits. / Most rhythm games have their volume turned down very low, ask one of the clerks for assistance and they will helpfully adjust the game's volume to your preference.

13003.info_text: Bowling Alley and amusement center with a small arcade in it's interior. / Play cards are priced at the following: / - $25 play card / - $50 play card / - $100 play card / - $25 for 1 hr unlimited play on green swipe machines

13004.info_text: Awesome arcade that recently opened on August 2021. Has a bunch of old school arcade games and pinball machines. Costs $10/Hour or $20 for all day to play on all arcade machines for free which is probably the best deal you'll find. (Now with a party room, Pricing on website for more information)

13006.info_text: A little arcade featuring mostly classic games,has DDR and many other games! / Temporarily closed as of 08/16/2025.

13007.info_text: A free community space dedicated to the Japanese Game Center experience. / We're open many days a week (hours change weekly) - hop into our discord to join the fun! https://discord.gg / j5aAFR3zwz (remove the spaces)

13008.info_text: An Anime Store specializing Gundam Models, Dragon Ball Z & Super Character Models, Anime Character Figurines, Japanese Drinks & Snacks, & Other Stuff. / For More Information: / https://www.rrotakucafe.com/ / Arcade Pricing: / 1 Hour - $5 / 2 Hours - $7 / All-Day - $10 / Specials: / Tuesdays - $5 (All-Day) / (ALL CABINETS ARE CONNECTED ONLINE UNOFFICIALLY)

13009.info_text: Rigby's is an entertainment complex featuring roller skating, bowling (string pin), mini-golf, and an arcade.

13010.info_text: Small arcade. No water fountains, but they give you free cups of Ice-Water for playing on the DDR machine. Hours seem to vary on weekdays depending on the weather, especially during winter. Call before you go. / If you walk straight in and take a peek at the wall next to the drink cooler, there's pictures of past DDR Tournament winners including Kevbo, and I believe Dr. D too.

13011.info_text: The entrance to the arcade is completely open like a store inside a mall. Machines take tokens, so use the token machines to convert dollars (and maybe coins) to tokens. / The In The Groove upgrade cabinet was removed sometime between May 2011 and June 2012 (on July 1, 2012, an employee said it had been removed "a long time ago"). Percussion Master also seems to have been removed. As of April 2014, Pump It Up seems to be gone.

13012.info_text: SuperNOVA2 cabinet, 75 cents for three songs. 1P pad isn't so great, you have to hit solidly on the outside of the arrows. 2P pad is fine. Machine could stand to be a little louder. Location is mostly deserted, don't expect to be waiting in line. / Sometimes on weekdays the billiards class comes in and turns off all the arcade machines for a couple hours.

13014.info_text: Family friendly gaming center in downtown Rahway. Almost all games are set to free play, with only the claw machine taking dollar bills and Maimai requiring credits, which can be purchased separately at the front desk. Cost of entry is $9.15 per hour, prorated every 15 minutes after the first hour. You can also purchase a day pass for $23.49, and a monthly pass (Mon-Thu) for $56.07. The hourly pass cost will never exceed the cost of a day pass. / In addition to the cabs, there are a large number of flat screen TVs with various modern consoles connected such as Xbox, PS, and Switch, featuring a lot of the newest games including Street Fighter 6 and Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom as of June 2023. There is also an custom Clone Hero setup towards the front of the arcade. The location stocks a small selection of board games behind the front counter. You can also purchase Amusement IC cards from the front counter to save your progress in the rhythm games that support it. / Venue is BYOB (beer and wine only) after 8 PM, and no children are allowed on the premises after 9 PM. / They also hold weekly smash tournaments every monday at 7 PM.

13015.info_text: Uses tokens; 1 token = 1 quarter. / Enforces curfew, 10:00pm/22:00 til sunrise, which is usually read as 5:00am. During events, this curfew begins earlier to 6:00pm/18:00. Has two arcades, one by the movie theater and one at the bowling alley. Both are in smoking areas and are loud during busy hours.

13016.info_text: ADULTS ONLY AFTER 10PM / Located in the heart of Downtown Riverside, The Riverside Game Lab offers a unique Virtual Reality gaming experience, alongside classic arcade games, pinball machines, and more. As part of the Fox Entertainment Plaza, we are only feet from both the Fox Performing Arts Theatre and Riverside Food Lab. We offer over 60 Video Arcades, Pinballs, Basketball and Air Hockey games, six virtual reality stations, and our exclusive VR Suite. / Whether you are with your date or have brought out the entire family, our VR stations are perfect for small groups. If you want to plan a big party for you and your friends, our arcade space along with our private reservation rooms can accommodate all of your large party needs. / We keep a variety of craft beers, snacks, and merchandise stocked, but if you are looking for a full meal, the Riverside Food Lab is just steps away. We allow and encourage all of our guests to bring food in from the Riverside Food Lab and enjoy it with their arcade experience inside of the Game Lab. / Keep your eyes open for special Game Lab events! Movie nights, classic consoles, casual tournaments (with prizes!), and much more. Be sure to check out...

13017.info_text: Email address if you'd like to reach out to the company to attempt to get them to properly maintain their SMX machine: / General Manager - marrick@roadhousecinemas.com / Roadhouse Cinemas - info.coloradosprings@roadhousecinemas.com / Rail Yard Gaming + Gastropub - info.coloradosprings@railyardgamingpub.com

13018.info_text: All games set to free play. Price at door is 15 dollars, or has an available combo ticket for access to both the Starcade and the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=11064#summary]Roanoke Pinball Museum[/url][/b] right next door. / Regular maintenance on all cabs. Yearly memberships are also available.

13020.info_text: Machine quality is Good. Both sides work very well with good detection and extremely low delay, sound is good, most lights work, bars are solid. / $1 for 3 songs, 45 second menu timer. / Machine is running R23 patch. / Change machine located near concession stand. / The movie theatre doesn't always allow access to the arcade without first purchasing a ticket, as the arcade is located past the ticket splitter.

13021.info_text: Self-Serve Bubble Tea Shop, Chicken Tenders and Small Bites, Bakery and Cookies. / Has DDR Supernova, free play for all customers

13022.info_text: Large retro-styled music-themed arcade along the Pigeon Forge Parkway. Was formerly home to a go-kart slick track as well, but as of March 2026, that has been removed, and now only exists as an indoor arcade. / All games take reloadable game cards. / Their DDR cab has been removed at some point over the past several years as well, leaving Guitar Hero as the sole rhythm game on site.

13023.info_text: SMX / 6 credits per song (machine is currently set to one song per session). 5.4 credits for VIP members. Machine not online and very quiet. / Prices: / $5 - 20 credits / $10 - 40 credits / $20 - 90 credits / $50 - 265 credits / $100 - 600 credits

13025.info_text: In back by Bowling Lanes, inside in arcade, right behind wall / Game list from website: / 5 different claw games with a variety to toys, sports memorabilia, candy and accessories / 3 separate racing games (2-player compatible) / Jurassic Park game (2-player compatible) / Guitar Hero (2-player compatible) / Dance Dance Revolution (2-player compatible) / Air Hockey / Pin Ball / Small Carousel / Change machines to swap cash to quarters

13026.info_text: Golfland's largest location in California, Sunsplash includes a full-sized water park as well as go-karts, mini-golf, bumper cars, and laser tag. / [i]Location: [/i] A few blocks away from I-80/CA-65 interchange. From Highway 65, take the Galleria Blvd South exit. Take a left on Roseville Pkwy and make a right on Taylor. The park will be on the right at the next light. From I-80 East Simply take the Atlantic Street Exit and stay straight on Taylor Road until you make to to the light and make a left. From I-80 west, take the Eureka Road exit, then make a left on Taylor. / [i]Payment: [/i] Arcades use a reloadable card that stores points (game credits) and tickets. Points are worth 20¢, while spending over $20 earns you bonus points. You can also buy a time-play card that allows you to play most games unlimited for a certain amount of time (tickets will be forfeited and games with pink and teal colored card readers will refuse to play). Card values don't carry to other locations. [url=https://store.golfland.com/season/]Memberships and season passes[/url] allow you to load a game card with 20 points (for basic and silver memberships) or 30 points for Gold and Platinum memberships)...

13027.info_text: Games here operate on a token system. You can purchase tokens from a nearby exchange machine using either cash or a credit card. The standard rate is $1 for 4 tokens, though larger purchases (such as $5, $10, or $20) may give you bonus tokens for better value. / An arcade attendant mentioned that they had previously imported offline versions of CHUNITHM and Sound Voltex to other unknown locations nearby, though they haven’t performed particularly well. Hopefully, the arcade considers bringing more rhythm game cabinets to this area in the future.

13028.info_text: Location is in the mall on the lower level across from the Ice. From the I-20 "alternate" entrance, turn right, go past the AMC logo, and turn left at the parking garage. If parking, enter from the multi level garage adjacent to JCPenney or in the parking lot in front of Nordstrom Rack. / Dec 2024 - Most Rhythm games are all located to the right as you enter. Crane games wll be to your left, fighting and racing games straight back near bowling lanes. / Note that eAmuse servers are offline 5-7am in Japan, so eA cards are not usable 3-5pm Central Daylight Time (2-4pm Central Standard Time). Note that the cutoff is strict -- your last round's achievements will NOT save if their servers don't receive your data in time. Be careful! / There's even free guest WiFi.

13037.info_text: At the north end of the mall, near Macy's and Dick's. / Entry is free, but game cards are needed to pay for arcade games. There are a couple of options available, visit the front counter for more information. / Most music games are 8.4 credits per play. 13059.info_text: Spo-Cha at Round1 is a separate entry "sports challenge" complex with a variety of activities for all ages, including trampolines, batting cages, roller skating, and more. Unlike the main Round1, this area requires a paid, timed admission. It is also home to a large free-play arcade, included with your admission. There is a large selection of rhythm games, mostly older and less-popular games that have rotated off the main floor and no longer have online service available. / Pricing depends upon the amount of time you want to spend inside (90 minutes, 3 hours, or all day), and can vary whether it's a weekday, weekend, or holiday. Check at the main counter at the Spo-Cha entrance for the most up-to-date pricing. / This listing is only for the games that are located inside the Spo-Cha arcade. For all other games, please see the listing for [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=4979#summary]Round1 Bowling and Arcade (Cumberland Mall)[/url][/b].

13122.info_text: Amusement park established in 1928 for the residents and guests of Westchester County, New York. Famed for being the site of Mariah Carey's "Fantasy" music video and the Tom Hanks film "Big". The arcade on site is located directly next to their classic carousel. The arcade has been revamped and remodeled for the 2024 season and features a number of modern racing games, claw machines, redemption games, and so on. There is no prize counter at the arcade for you to redeem tickets that you've won; if you wish to do so, you must go down past the Dragon Coaster all the way near the exit to the parking lot and find the Skee-Ball alley. There is a small prize counter over there. / All games now take game cards. Pricing is as follows: / $5 - 20 credits (25¢/credit) / Same pricing as above for $10 or $20 cards / $25 - 120 credits (20.8¢/credit) / $50 - 250 credits (20¢/credit) / Hours for Playland are seasonal and subject to change; please check the website for the most up-to-date operating hours. All machines take nickels. / Special admission deals available, call the arcade for specials. / Facebook page not frequently updated / +-+-+- Skip to the section below for detailed information about the arcade -+-+-+ / For the last 13 years, his arcade is where the majority of the local music game community hung out. Once known as UtahDDR, we became Beatgamer and spent many years here at the Sandy Nickelcade running tournaments, lock-ins, game nights for local conventions, or just regular meetups. This is where friendships were made, and where we spent some of the best times of our lives. / Over the years, the arcade fell into disrepair. At one point, rather than letting the only playable ITG machine go to waste, the community got together and decided to fully fund the repair and maintenance of the machine when the owner was not able to. One of our community members spent thousands of dollars, and many others donated their own time and money to make sure the machine was maintained as best we could. / We were even able to bring in arcade machines that we owned ourselves to allow others to play. The state's very first Beatmania IIDX machine was placed here,...

13128.info_text: The Santa Cruz Beach Boardwalk is a famous amusement park that's been featured in the Lost Boys film, and it's the oldest amusement park still operating in California. It's split between a midway section with rides, and an arcade section on the west side. The arcade section is open seven days a week and features two arcades, the Casino Arcade and Neptunes Kingdom. Redemption is at the Casino. There is also the Funland Arcade, located at the east end of the park, and is open during ride hours. Games may rotate between these arcades and [url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=11134]Boardwalk Bowl[/url]. / Payment: All arcade games use tap-to-play [url=https://beachboardwalk.com/myboardwalk/]MyBoardwalk Cards[/url]. Each point costs one dollar, while the card is free with point purchase. $50 load gives 5 bonus points, $100 load gives 15 bonus points. Paid points can also be used at concessions and retail shops along the boardwalk. Bonus points are only for arcades, rides, midway games, etc. / Hours as of 6/13/2022: / "Opening Times" refer to Casino Arcade and Neptune's Kingdom, which also include Mini Golf, Billiards, Laser Tag, and the bar upstairs Neptune's Kingdom....

13132.info_text: Scandia is Golfland's Fairfield, CA location. [i]This park has two arcades: the Main Arcade to the left of the restaurant entrance, and the Grand Arcade to the right. [/i] Other attractions are OmniArena VR, mini golf, go-karts, laser tag, batting cages, and bumper boats. and an indoor playground for kids under 12 years old. / [i]Location:[/i] near the 80/12/680 interchange in Cordelia, the most direct way to get there by freeway is to take the Suisun Valley Road exit off Interstate 80. It is also served by [url=https://fasttransit.org/microtransit/]FAST Connect[/url]. / [i]Payment: [/i] Arcades use a reloadable card that stores points (game credits) and tickets. Points are worth 20¢, while spending over $20 earns you bonus points. You can also buy a time-play card that allows you to play most games unlimited for a certain amount of time (tickets will be forfeited and games with pink and teal colored card readers will refuse to play). Card values don't carry to other locations. [url=https://store.golfland.com/season/]Memberships and season passes[/url] allow you to load a game card with 20 points (for basic and silver memberships) or 30 points for Gold and Platinum memberships)...

13140.info_text: Brand new Arcade opened on July 1st 2023. It has a mix of classic original games as well as newer games and a decent redemption wall selection.

13143.info_text: Very arcade-friendly atmosphere inside of this bowling alley location. The machines are located in a separate room to the left immediately after walking inside. In addition to storing credit, they also keep track of how many tickets are won from the redemption games.

13144.info_text: Formerly: "DDR extreme is in the Arcade room. / The arcade is dark and games requires tokens. / The volume is turned down but the bass is good. / The panels are fine and mostly responsive. / 50 cents a play / 50 more cents for 2 player/doubles" / It was known previously as Sunset Lanes, but it's been combined with a weed dispensary and the name has been changed. They don't have pictures of the interior, but there's a good chance the EX cab is not there anymore.

I go by Shadowfox31 / Krieger. / At my apartment I got a Pop'n music cab and Jubeat cab. / Placing my pin in downdown so nobody just comes to my apartment un-announced, but I do live in New bern. 13147.info_text: Known variously as "Shake Shoppe", "Shake Shoppe Arcade", "Hershey's Shake Shoppe Arcade", "Primetime Arcade", or "that one arcade with the giant ice cream cone outside". The Shake Shoppe is the northernmost arcade on the Seaside Heights boardwalk and another one of the many, many boardwalk arcades in the area that have a heavy emphasis on redemption and crane games. / Much like its brethren up and down the boardwalk, the games at this arcade can be played with reloadable game cards, coins, or bills. Almost every machine has a bill reader installed on it. Unlike most of the other arcades, the game card credits do not equate to dollars at a 1 to 1 ratio; 1 dollar is equivalent to 6 credits. For the purposes of this list, game pricing will be given in dollar amounts. However, you can gain some bonus credits by purchasing game cards in $20 or higher increments; / $1 = 6 credits (~16.7 cents / credit) / $5 = 30 credits (as above) / $10 = 60 credits (as above) / $20 = 140 credits (~14.3 cents / credit) / $50 = 400 credits (12.5 cents / credit) / $100 = 1000 credits (10 cents / credit) / Hours of operation may vary seasonally. Their website is out of date and they don't post current h...

13149.info_text: Indoor mini golf, escape room, and arcade located on the second floor of Statewide Oil & Heating in Red Hook, Brooklyn. Established 2016. / All games in the arcade take game cards. Each new game card will have 4 credits deducted from the final credit amount to cover the cost of the card. Current pricing for refills is as follows: / $10 - 40 credits (25¢/credit) / $20 - 100 credits (20¢/credit) / $50 - 280 credits (17.8¢/credit) / $100 - 600 credits (16.6¢/credit) / On Thursdays, arcade games are half-price between the hours of 3 PM and 6 PM. Also on Thursdays, the facility is 21+ only after 7 PM.

13150.info_text: Formerly known as "Arnie's Playland", this medium sized arcade is located on the second floor of the Bethany Town Center in Bethany Beach, Delaware. Open daily during the summer season, call or check the website before Memorial Day or after Labor Day for more current hours. / As of September 8th, 2024, they have switched to their off-season hours which are closed Mondays through Thursdays, 12 PM to 10 PM Fridays, 10 AM to 10 PM Saturdays, and 10 AM to 7 PM Sundays. / The same people also operate the [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=9324#summary]Shore Fun Arcade[/url][/b] a few miles south in Fenwick Island. Game cards purchased at either location will work in both arcades.

13151.info_text: Bowling center located just off the West Shore Expressway in Staten Island. Supposedly has a small arcade on site, but upon visiting them after dark in November 2023, all the lights were off and marquees were missing. Phone calls after the fact verified that they are in fact still open but just "don't advertise". Check it at your own risk as it's kind of sketchy. / Update 6/6/2025: The building still has an active bowling alley. Arcade is open Fridays and Saturdays starting from 3pm. DDR cabinet currently has a broken monitor that the staff had informed me they ordered a replacement part for. / Update as of February 25th, 2024; visited again as we were in the area, still very sketchy vibes, but building was actually open for bowling mid-day. However, the arcade room was closed, lights were off, and doors were locked. Upon asking someone at the counter, they said it was closed because of a bowling tournament (???) and it might be open tomorrow (???). Visually verified that the DDR Supernova cab is in fact still there. Another room elsewhere in the building houses the remnants of a now-defunct Wendy's and also appears to have House of the Dead III, Time Crisis 3, and an unidentifi...

13152.info_text: This bowling alley is rather large and nice (for a bowling alley). Smells like smoke, but not much else you can expect there. :p

13153.info_text: $10 entry fee, games are all on freeplay.

13154.info_text: Silverball is a bar/arcade with around 4 pinball machines, arcades, skeeball, pop-a-shot, air hockey, foosball, bubble hockey, and more. There are 6 frozen drink machines with Premium drink mixes as well as beer and other alcohol options. The Silverball Lounge can be booked for private events.

13155.info_text: Sir Goony's has 2 really good mini-golf courses, both are worth playing if you have the time and inclination. Also has go karts, batting cages, bumper boats, and a few kiddie rides. The place gets ridiculously crowded some summer Saturdays and the entire month of October for Halloween. / Sadly, the machine is a dollar for an old Exceed 2. I don't think there are any plans to upgrade. If you're here in Chattanooga and need a Pump fix, this is the only place I know of in the city proper (there's another machine 30 minutes north in Cleveland, an NX). On the plus side, however, the pads are pretty good, the game is loud enough to hear the music well, and the screen is bright. Bars, if you want to use them, are firm on left and slightly wobbly on right.

13156.info_text: Hours of operation vary by day. / $22 parking / $50 admission

13157.info_text: Indoor resort with suites, a waterpark, a Johnny Rockets restaurant, and multiple arcades on site. The majority of the games are located on the first floor's "Starlight Arcade", located to the right of the main entrance and check-in desk. There is a smaller "North Star Arcade" located on the second floor directly above the check-in desk. There were also previously additional prize redemption games and claw machines down on the ground floor near the entrance to Johnny Rockets, but as of the 2024 season, they are converting Johnny Rockets into a Hurricane Grill & Wings, and that entire section is closed off to the public. / Most games take game cards, with the option to use credit cards instead for a slight surcharge (ie 10 credits = $1.10 credit card price). Current game card pricing as of September 2023 is as follows: / $15 = 149 credits (~10.1¢ per credit) / $25 = 279 credits (~8.9¢ per credit) / $50 = 579 credits (~8.6¢ per credit) / $75 = 899 credits (~8.3¢ per credit) / $100 = 1299 credits (~7.7¢ per credit) / As this is the hotel property to the adjacent [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7503#summary]Six Flags Great Escape[/url][/b] theme park, busine...

13158.info_text: I visited this park only once in March of 2009, so apologies that the details are hazy. Park hours vary - they have a day-to-day calendar [url=http://www.sixflags.com/overTexas/info/parkInfo.aspx]here on their site[/url] so you can plan ahead. / [b]Machine details:[/b] / -DDR Extreme (all unlocks) / -Price: Must purchase a rechargeable playcard before use of the games. IIRC the card is $2 and it was $1/3 songs, no joint premium. / -Bars: Decent / -Pads: The right side is slightly preferred here. / -Fans: None (suggested when I was there). / -Water: No fountain; think I got a water cup from a nearby food chain. / [b]Condition:[/b] / The right side had very slight pad error (I could still full-combo songs, but sometimes an arrow would flub) and the left side messed up a little bit more often. Both sides are playable. / [b]Location:[/b] / It's in an arcade in the Mexico area of the park. ([url=http://www.sixflags.com/overTexas/info/parkMap.aspx]View/Print park map here[/url]). The area is on your left as you come in, following the path but before you get to the big red tower. / [b]Accessibility:[/b] / The game has some regulars, so you can probably expect another player to show up...

13163.info_text: Indoor trampoline park with a medium sized arcade located to the right of the main entrance. / All games use credits loaded on a generic Intercard system arcade card. 13172.info_text: Indoor 18-hole blacklight mini golf course and mirror maze, located inside the massive [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=7232#summary]Palisades Center[/url][/b] mall in the Hudson Valley, West Nyack, NY. They have a moderate selection of arcade games located in their lobby, and as of August 2023 just recently added their first rhythm game with a deluxe StepManiaX cabinet. / All games at this location accept game cards. Game cards from this location also currently work at [b][url=https://zenius-i-vanisher.com/v5.2/arcade.php?id=6681#summary]The Arcade House[/url][/b] on the mall's 3rd floor, and vice versa. / Credit pricing: / $10 - 40 credits (25¢ per credit) / $20 - 100 credits (20¢ per credit) / $30 - 160 credits (~19¢ per credit) / $40 - 225 credits (~18¢ per credit) / $100 - 712 credits (~14¢ per credit)

Cards from other Space Adventure Mini Golf and Aracde House locations are accepted

13181.info_text: We have an extensive collection of vintage and rare pinball machines for you to play. We also house a striking assemblage of various retro video arcade games, vintage skeeball and various other games – there’s over 130 games on the arcade floor. / Across the hall from the main Spark's Pinball Museum area is a second unit with 17 Japanese Import Machines titled Sparks Passport. 13183.info_text: A cool Go-Kart place that is Open 365 Days A Year,Including All Holidays. Also has Laser Tag, and Mini Golf.

13190.info_text: ***Many of the game listings are out of date. Please help update this information if you're able to do so. Prices listed in Credits represent updated data; old game data still shows prices listed in $.*** / ***Their hours change weekly, so check https://sportimeusa.com/contact/ for the current hours before you visit.*** / This location is also known as Life: The Place To Be. There are a lot of things that can be done here. There are rides, laser tag, redemption games, arcade games, and air hockey, plus a soft play area for kids. The parking is free, birthday parties are hosted, and there's no admission fee to enter the arcade. The card swipers charge your card for X number of credits when you swipe...

13191.info_text: Large arcade on the Ocean City boardwalk near the Jolly Roger At The Pier amusement park. Mostly redemption games and crane machines these days, as they have gradually phased out most rhythm games from this location. / Most games allow you to use either cash or an Intercard system game card to pay. If you use cash, the machines will spit out paper tickets, but if you use a card, it will store e-tickets directly on your card. You can get bonus credit on your card for loading higher values: / $20 - $2 bonus credit / $40 - $5 bonus credit / $50 - $8 bonus credit / $100 - $25 bonus credit / Seasonal hours apply; check the website or give them a call for the most current operating hours during the off-season.

13192.info_text: Movie theater with a small arcade room by the lobby. Other games like PIU, ice hockey, and a billiards table are in the main lobby near the concession stand. Game locations can change every now and then.

13193.info_text: Private basement arcade in the sticks, the address is not correct for privacy reasons. Please PM if you want to play. / DDR A20+, Chunithm Paradise Lost & Nostalgia Op.3 Cabinets. BeatStream runs on my Nostalgia cab and I have a IIDX setup as well.

13194.info_text: Primarily a bowling alley. All minors (under 18) must be accompanied at all times by an adult 25 or older. Maximum 6 minors to 1 adult. DDR MACHINE NO LONGER THERE

13195.info_text: Founded on January 11, 1985 / Star Worlds Arcade is the DeKalb area's only real pinball and video arcade. Kids of all ages will love our video games, pinballs, and shuffle alley. Never a door charge to enter the arcade. Our Vintage Vault offers players the real machines from the 80's. / Locally owned and operated for over 28 years. Inducted into the Twin Galaxies International Registry of Historic Video Game Arcades as one of history's original Golden Age Arcades from the 1980s. We have many classic arcade games that are well maintained as if it is still the early 1980's. Check out the "about us" link on our website to see what's been written about Star Worlds Arcade in the past 7 years. Private parties also possible for gamers of all ages. / 30 TOKENS FOR $5.00 (value)

13198.info_text: $11 + tax for daily membership / $38 + tax for one month membership / All machines are set to free-play. 13259.info_text: An independent indoor/outdoor family entertainment center located in the Hudson Valley, just a couple miles from Legoland New York. Outdoor attractions include go-karts, a zip line, two 18-hole mini golf courses, and a selection of rides such as bumper cars and a kiddie roller coaster. Indoor attractions include an inflatable obstacle park, laser tag, a laser maze, a rock climbing wall, axe throwing, and a decent sized arcade with a mixed variety of different games. / All arcade games operate via card swipers. Cards can be loaded with cash at self-serve machines or at the main counter. $1 equates to 100 points on a card; there is no bonus given for loading more cash at a time. / Hours change seasonally. From May through August, they are open daily, but from September through April they close Mondays and Tuesdays. The hours listed below are current through June 22nd, 2023. Be sure to check the website for the most up-to-date information before visiting.

13260.info_text: Establishment runs on a card system. / The card just holds money on it. If you buy $100 card for example, games that cost 1$ would lower your cards value by $1 and will be left with $99 remaining on your card. There are easy kiosks to fill your card up, they accept cash(no coins) and credit/debit cards. / If you come for the StepmaniaX machine, just be aware that there are usually a ton of kids here on the weekend and you may have to deal with kids hopping on and off the machine during play. Not that big of a deal for some, but in case it is for you. / This place also has a lot of other arcade games. In a very mild sense it is very similar to Dave and Busters but with go karts, laser tag, and other attractions.

13261.info_text: Small arcade located on the second floor of the historic Claridge Hotel, just off the Atlantic City boardwalk. All games take tokens, and there are change machines on site that accept bills, credit cards, or tap-to-pay. Hours are not posted.

13262.info_text: This is located next to the Hackers Golf Park, just off of Veteran's Memorial Parkway and just over a mile from GSU. / A card reader is used for payment in the arcade (which is located to the left when you walk in), but a card is free and game prices and card balances are shown in dollar amounts, not an arbitrary points system. The arcade is a mixture of redemption games and non-redemption games. / In addition to the arcade, there are 24 string pin bowling lanes here, a laser tag arena, a playground, a restaurant, and batting cages. / There are NO DDR, Pump It Up, or StepmaniaX here.

13263.info_text: The Clubhouse Family Fun Centre is a new entertainment space inside Nittany Valley Sports Centre, created for families, teams, and groups to play, gather, and spend time together. With 70 arcade games and virtual reality experiences, dedicated space for casual fun inside The Centre, it’s designed to fit naturally into your day at the Centre. / Whether you’re stopping by for a quick visit, celebrating a birthday, meeting up after practice, or planning a group outing, The Clubhouse offers an easy, flexible way to enjoy time together.

13265.info_text: An all-ages arcade featuring arcade games, both retro and modern; pinball; and claw machines. All machines use a card system. Drinks are available for purchase, including alcohol for those 21 and over.

Includes a sizable arcade, glow bowling lanes, billiards, a restaurant upstairs and a sports bar downstairs. All games take game cards. Current pricing as of January 2025 is as follows: / $1 - 3 chips (33.3¢/chip) / $5 - 20 chips (25¢/chip) / $10 - 50 chips (20¢/chip) / $20 - 120 chips (16.6¢/chip) / $25 - 150 chips (16.6¢/chip) / $50 - 400 chips (12.5¢/chip) / $100 - 1000 chips (10¢/chip) / Each card has a $1 activation fee, but cards are rechargeable. / Individual games have both regular pricing and VIP pricing. 13274.info_text: From the website: / What is The Forge? / The Forge is a Social Gaming Center, also known as a gaming lounge or e-sports lounge. It is a dedicated space where gamers can come together to play their favorite video games. We provide a unique experience for gamers, offering high-end equipment, comfortable seating, and food and beverage options. We try to foster a social and community atmosphere, allowing gamers to compete in tournaments, form their own communities, and engage in social interactions. / The Forge is not limited to just console or PC games. We also encompass online gaming platforms where people can both play and watch others play. We also encourage tabletop gaming, from Warhammer to Monopoly. Our community includes features such as a dedicated Discord server, activity feeds, leaderboards, and shareable content. We cater to a diverse audience from all walks of life, from casual gamers who enjoy single-player games to competitive gamers who participate in multiplayer games and tournaments. The Forge aims to become a significant part of the gaming culture in Tampa Bay, providing a platform for gamers to connect, compete, and share their gaming experiences. / Here at The F...

13275.info_text: This Lehigh Valley mainstay of retro gaming has reopened at its new location in downtown Easton as of mid-2025. The front half is primarily a used game store, while the back half is a coin drop arcade featuring a mix of mostly classic 80's, 90's, and 2000's video game cabinets and retro pinball machines. / All games take quarters and typically run between 25¢ to $1.00. There is no change machine on site, but they can make change for you at the front counter of the game shop. / As of September 2025, there are some electrical issues causing many of the games on the right side of the arcade section to be turned off, but they are expected to be back up and running again soon. / More imported rhythm games are expected to arrive at the arcade in the near future, stay tuned.

13300.info_text: Sonoma County’s first retro arcade bar, and Official Stern Army location, the Rewind features 80’s and 90’s arcade and pinball machines with a mix of newer arcade and pinball for the modern gamer and pinball savant. / A cutting edge self pour beer wall is integrated into the front of the room. [url=https://www.pressdemocrat.com/article/business/late-night-arcade-bar-the-rewind-is-coming-to-the-barlow-this-spring/]Press Democrat article[/url]. 13309.info_text: The Underground Arcade is located on the "Family Floor" (its really the ground floor of the place) of Black Oak Casino. / The staff is friendly and the arcade is usually empty during the week but gets pretty busy during the weekends, sometimes on busy nights cigarette smoke from the second floor does billow down the escalator and that does become a problem. / Machines are kept in pretty good condition with only a couple of games out of order here and there. / DDR Extreme cab Has Been converted to an OpenITG Cab and ,as of this post, ALL the pad sensors have been replaced and the rest of the cabinet has been Refurbished/Refreshed. / During the Summer the arcade opens at 9am instead of the normal 2pm.

13310.info_text: Two-story all-ages entertainment center with duckpin bowling, billiards, pinball, arcade games, and a bar. The bottom floor has some arcade games with the top floor containing even more arcade games and pinball machines.

13312.info_text: my personal arcade if you like to play games. just help me move them and plug them in. currently free play for everything. / please call or text before coming so i can get systems ready. / DDR extreme / pump it up / virtual on / Daytona usa / and more
